title: Senior Professional Project Manager - Aero CMU
jd_text: Job Description Summary Senior Professional CMU Project Manager will oversee projects for the GEV Services CMU organization. 3-5 year PM experience highly recommended. Types of projects will vary but are not limited to, Complex Scoped Projects, TruePackage Refurbishment, Repowering, BOP Systems, Controls Upgrades, Fuel Systems, etc,. PM is responsible for project delivery per scope of supply, profit & loss accountability, and customer satisfaction through management of project related activities and resources. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance. Job Description • Serve as the GE representative and focal point for the customer on the project, owning the customer relationship for the project duration and driving customer issue resolution. • Team with sourcing to manage suppliers during package (TruePackage) or equipment refurbishment phase. These projects are typically complex in nature and require detail oversight and business leadership reporting. • Understanding of all aspects of TruePackage or Repowering in situations where GEV might elect to self-implement. Understanding of supplier and labor requirements to perform are critical. • Support ITO teams during the quoting of TruePackage and Repowers with lessons learned with scope of supply and contractual language to mitigate risk and protect margin. • Own project execution, including cross-functional coordination of engineering, procurement, shipping logistics, field/ outage execution and performance demonstration. • Provide Project Leadership, effectively managing and facilitating cross-functional GE teams to ensure on time delivery, contract deliverables fulfilment, and margin attainment/ enhancement. • Understand and implement Contract Terms & Conditions. • Manage project financials: price, cost, forecasts, margin, invoicing, and receivables. Manage project risk provisions and participate in Margin Reviews. • Drive project schedule; work with Project Planner/Scheduler on schedule creation and management. • Proactively identify, manage, and mitigate project risks throughout the project lifecycle. Escalate risks and issues as needed for resolution. • Actively manage project changes with the Customer and project team, following the change management process. • Maintain Project Management system with current scope, schedule, financials, risks, etc. Maintain project documentation. • Provide project status updates and lead Project Reviews as required. • Capture and report project best practices/ lessons learned and Cost-of-Poor Quality cases. • Follow CM&U Project Management processes. Qualifications/Requirements Bachelor’s degree preferred, or a combination of education and equivalent work experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the role. Eligibility Requirements: Ability and willingness to travel (~25%) Desired Characteristics Demonstrated project management skills and passion for Project Management. Skilled at leading and influencing cross functional team members in a matrix organization. Skilled Communicator; professional and tactful in oral and written communications with multiple GE functions/levels and with the Customer; applies good judgment on frequency and detail of communication. Confident yet humble. Ability to tactfully ask questions to create clarity and transparency on projects. Excellent planning and organizational skills. Ability to effectively switch-task and manage multiple projects at the same time. Ability to quickly respond to and manage project changes. Motivated to plan and lead team as well as to manage project administration. Appetite for learning PM processes and tools, as well as CM&U products and technology updates. Ability to set realistic objectives, accurately appraise situations, detect risks and issues, and collaborate with GE internal teams and customer to find win-win solutions. Embraces and demonstrates sensitivity to culture of customer and internal team members. Experience interpreting or applying Contract terms & conditions and binding agreements. Understanding of GE financial processes, revenue recognition, costs, margin, and quarterly forecasting. Understanding of project scheduling; ability to manage critical path activities to meet outage date. Minimum of 5 years of experience in either field engineering, commercial, engineering, sourcing, repair, power plant operation and maintenance or other adjacent role with Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, Generators, Heat Recovery Steam Generators, or Aero-derivatives. Extended scope experience involving power plant equipment and auxiliary systems. Direct customer-facing experience. PMP Certification, Project Management Leadership Program (PMLP) Graduate, or other Project Management training. title: Senior Project Manager - FACTS

title: Senior Project Manager - Steam Power - Nuclear
jd_text: Job Description Summary GE Vernova (NYSE: GEV) Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our singular mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously working to help decarbonize it. If we want our energy future to be different…we must be different. Our mission is embedded in our name. We retain our treasured legacy, “GE,” in our name as an enduring and hard-earned badge of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” / “verde” signal Earth’s verdant and lush ecosystems. “Nova,” from the Latin “novus,” nods to a new, innovative era of lower carbon energy that GE Vernova will help deliver. Together, we have The Energy to Change the World. Learn more at www.gevernova.com The Sr Project Manager – Steam Power - Nuclear is responsible for Project Management, Planning, and Coordination typically in the context of a Services Project to fulfill GE Vernova’s customer outage requirements for the Nuclear Power Business, according to financial/commercial parameters and ensuring customer satisfaction. The role is focused on the execution of outage activities, within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. Job Description What you’ll do Provide project leadership and guidance from project conception through to project delivery; to the customer and to conduct project feedback reviews at the appropriate time Development and management of costs with ongoing estimates to completion of projects Development, planning and management of the project schedules and payment milestones, while providing contingency planning where required, to ensure a timely delivery Managing the contractual scope content ensuring all stakeholders are kept informed Risk and Opportunity management. Ensuring that all risks and issues are identified and mitigated To communicate effectively with all the stakeholders, both internal and external while maintaining excellent relations with customers, peers, Engineering, and global teams It is expected that this position will act as the focus for project-based activities and perform other related duties as assigned or requested What you’ll bring (Basic Qualifications) Bachelor's degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related technical discipline from an accredited university or college. Minimum of 5+ years of relevant project management experience within the power generation or industrial manufacturing industry. Ability to gain unescorted access to a Nuclear power facility in Canada or U.S. Ability to travel, up to 30% annually, domestically and internationally. Ability to obtain and maintain a valid passport. Ability to work at customer site as required What will make you stand out Professional Engineering Certification PMP Certification Experience with Steam Power systems either in a Nuclear, Fossil or Industrial power plant setting Practical knowledge of GE Vernova products is a plus but not necessity Ability to adapt to changing technology Attention to detail and time management skills to ensure deadlines are met Clear thinker, detail oriented, insightful, quantitative, and results oriented – Able to make reasoned, sound, and timely decisions Strong facilitation and presentation skills for technical and business audiences Able and willing to take ownership and responsibility for assigned tasks Able to work successfully in a matrix environment, executing multiple assignments and priorities Continuous improvement “mindset” with an ability to identify, influence, and implement better ways to execute an activity or process Proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint and working knowledge of Primavera P6 Strong verbal communication skills and customer focused mindset Strong oral and written communication skills Strong interpersonal and leadership skills You must have legal authorization to work in Canada, and any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation: the drug screen requirement in the background check process is not required if the role is based in Canada. title: Service Project Manager – CIC, P&C & M&D
jd_text: Job Description Summary Position Summary The Service Project Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, execution, and successful completion of customer service projects across Critical Industrial Communications (CIC), Protection & Control (P&C), and Monitoring & Diagnostics (M&D). The position serves as the primary project-management interface between the customer and internal technical, engineering, field service, production, supply chain, and commercial teams. The Service Project Manager is accountable for ensuring projects are executed safely, on schedule, within approved budgets, to defined scope, and in accordance with customer requirements. The role manages projects through the complete service lifecycle, including project initiation, planning, engineering coordination, material and resource planning, field execution, customer acceptance, financial management, and project closeout. Job Description Essential Responsibilities: Project Execution: Lead the execution of complex projects within the Grid Automation solutions domain. Primary Focus on CIC, P&C, and M&D. Ensure alignment of project goals with overall business objectives. Manage project budgets, timelines, and resources effectively. Ensure safety and quality through the overall execution cycle. Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, vendors, and cross-functional teams. Ensure clear communication and manage expectations throughout the life cycle of all projects in the portfolio. Create a strong customer intimacy and ensure its satisfaction during execution. Project Planning, Scheduling and Resources: Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Utilize planning and scheduling tools to monitor progress, manage the critical path and deliver the project in time. Ensure optimal usage of project resources partnering with the Engineering and Services department. Project Budget: Ensure optimal budget control developing clear work breakdown structure and monitoring Earned Value (EV) also called Budgeted Cost of Work Performed (BCWP). Enhance project financial defining saving strategy and maximizing variation orders during execution. Risk Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate risks identified during project execution. Implement contingency plans to address unforeseen challenges. Quality Assurance: Ensure all project deliverables meet quality standards and regulatory requirements. Conduct regular reviews and audits to maintain high standards of project execution. Reporting and Documentation: Prepare and present regular status reports to senior management and stakeholders. Maintain accurate and comprehensive project documentation. Required Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred. Experience: Minimum of 7 years of experience in project management within the energy or Grid Automation sector. Proven experience in managing complex, multi-faceted projects. Experience with protection relays, bay controller units, auxiliary relays, and telecom equipment is highly desirable. Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent certification preferred. Additional certifications in Grid Automation or related technologies are a plus. Skills: Strong leadership and team management skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g., MS Project, Jira). Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities. Ability to travel to customer sites and offices as required by the project plan (around 20%) Desired Characteristics: Deep understanding of Grid Automation solutions and industry standards. Experience with telecom equipment and network infrastructure. Knowledge of automation algorithms and human-machine interfaces. Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. For candidates applying to a Canadian-based position, the pay range for this position is between $92,800.00 and $139,200.00 CAD. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. Bonus eligibility: Annual Bonus This posting is for an existing vacancy. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No #LI-Remote - This is a remote position

title: Product Manager — Feature‑Rich CMOS Product Line
jd_text: About GlobalFoundries: GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com . Summary of Role: As a Product Manager for our feature‑rich CMOS product line, you will own product strategy and execution from market discovery through roadmap definition, requirements, and lifecycle management. You will partner closely with Engineering, Applications/FAE, Sales, Operations, and Marketing to deliver differentiated products that win in competitive design cycles and meet customer system-level needs. Essential Responsibilities : Product Strategy & Roadmap Define product vision, strategy, and multi-generation roadmap aligned to market trends and customer requirements Identify whitespace opportunities and translate insights into product concepts and business cases Requirements & Execution Own PRDs/MRDs and translate customer use cases into clear requirements (performance, power, area, cost, features, reliability, security, quality) Lead cross-functional tradeoff decisions across architecture, feature set, and cost targets Customer & Market Leadership Engage directly with customers and partners to capture voice-of-customer, validate requirements, and refine value propositions Support key design-ins with technical depth in collaboration with Sales and FAEs Business Ownership Manage product line P&L inputs: pricing strategy, competitive positioning, margin targets, and volume forecasts Track KPIs (pipeline, design wins, revenue, ASP, margin, attach/cross-sell) and drive actions to achieve targets Lifecycle Management Own lifecycle activities: product launch readiness, portfolio rationalization, PCNs/EOL planning, and sustaining priorities Cross-Functional Leadership Drive alignment across engineering, test, quality, operations, and commercial teams to deliver to schedule, cost, and performance commitments Other Responsibilities: Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. Required Qualifications : 5+ years experience in the semiconductor industry (product management, applications, systems, design, or related) Strong technical foundation (EE/CE/Physics or equivalent experience) with ability to engage on architecture and system-level tradeoffs Demonstrated customer knowledge: design cycles, qualification expectations, and decision drivers Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and make data-driven decisions Preferred Qualifications : Experience with CMOS feature-rich devices (e.g., mixed-signal, connectivity, MCU/SoC, imaging/sensing, interface ICs, power management in CMOS) Familiarity with silicon lifecycle realities (bring-up, errata management, qualification, yield/reliability, PCN/EOL) Experience with pricing/packaging strategy and competitive positioning Success Metrics Roadmap adoption and on-time milestone delivery Increased design wins and pipeline conversion Revenue/margin achievement and measurable competitive win rate Expected Salary Range $118,000.00 - $210,000.00 The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at usaccommodations@gf.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address. jd_text: Job Description Summary Product quality review associated with the manufacturing process. Impacts the team’s ability to achieve service, quality and timeliness of objectives. Job Description Work Location and Travel Remote eligible with a preference for candidates in the Northeast United States due to GE locations supported Ability to travel to supported GE Sites: Bromont, Hookset, Rutland Typical travel: 25% Roles and Responsibilities Safety Management System Implementation (Policy) – Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of the site’s SMS in alignment with enterprise SMS team and industry best practices. Ensure SMS documentation is accurate, accessible, and maintained. Safety Risk Management (SRM) – Facilitate risk identification, analysis, and mitigation through collaboration with site product Safety Action Team (SAT)/Groups and product Safety Review Boards (SRB). Incident Investigation and Reporting – Prepare and submit product safety performance reports to the Accountable SMS Delegate, safety review board, and enterprise SMS team as required. Compliance and Auditing (Safety Assurance)– Monitor site-level compliance with applicable enterprise SMS policies. Conduct regular product safety audits and inspections to ensure adherence to SMS requirements. Management of Change (Assurance) - Support product Safety Risk Management within change management initiatives. Training and Awareness (Product Safety Promotion) – Collaborate with the local training team or focal point to provide SMS and Human Factors training to employees across all levels of the site. Promote product safety awareness and a culture of continuous improvement. Collaboration and Communication (Product Safety Promotion) – Facilitate the distribution of product safety information. Drive initiatives to enhance product safety performance and reduce risks. Act as the liaison between the site-level operations and enterprise SMS team on matters pertaining to product safety. Collaborate with other sites to share lessons learned and address systemic issues or concerns. Facilitate communication and collaboration across all levels of the GE Aerospace enterprise (e.g. other MRO shops, other Part 21 shops, etc.) to ensure alignment with SMS objectives. Performance Monitoring and Improvement – Track and analyze product safety performance metrics to identify trends (drive proactive approach to SRM) and areas for improvement. Facilitate the independent review of investigations and just culture. Support customer and regulatory audits. title: Embedded Computing Research Engineer - Embedded Systems
jd_text: Job Description Summary As an Embedded Computing Research Engineer at GE Vernova’s Advanced Research Center, you will develop, implement, and test edge solutions for embedded systems that power industrial automation, networking, and enterprise software platforms. You will contribute hands-on across the full development lifecycle, from concept and architecture through implementation, integration, and verification. You will help execute multimillion-dollar research and development programs aligned with GE Vernova’s energy businesses, including Power, Wind, Electrification, and Grid Solutions, as well as U.S. Government agencies such as the Department of Defense and Department of Energy. The technologies you develop will be matured and transitioned into GE Vernova products. You will collaborate with teams across GE Vernova, suppliers, government partners, national laboratories, universities, and strategic business partners to advance innovative embedded computing solutions. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Develop, implement, and test edge and embedded software solutions for industrial automation, networking, and enterprise software platforms. Serve as a technical contributor on R&D tasks, translating program requirements into robust embedded-system designs and implementation plans. Develop firmware and application software in C/C++ and related languages for resource-constrained, real-time embedded platforms. Build, execute, and automate test plans, including unit, integration, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level verification. Support the maturation and transition of research prototypes into GE Vernova product platforms. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, suppliers, national laboratories, universities, and government partners to deliver program milestones. Contribute to proposals, technical reports, and program reviews for internal leadership and government sponsors. Apply secure-by-design principles and cybersecurity best practices throughout the embedded-software lifecycle. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with 1–5 years of relevant industry experience. A minimum of 1 year of professional experience in embedded systems, firmware, or edge software development. Demonstrated proficiency in embedded software development using C and/or C++. Experience with microcontrollers, microprocessors, or system-on-chip platforms and associated hardware interfaces, such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, or Ethernet. Familiarity with industrial communication protocols, such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, IEC 61850, MQTT, or BACnet, and data-serialization formats such as Protocol Buffers or JSON. Ability to integrate existing real-time analytics, anomaly-detection capabilities, and secure data pipelines into edge and embedded applications. Experience developing for Linux systems or real-time operating systems. Experience across the embedded-systems development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, and debugging. Desired Characteristics Familiarity with industrial control systems, programmable logic controllers, or edge controllers used in grid operations, industrial automation, or renewable-energy infrastructure. Experience with RTOS task scheduling, thread priorities, and strict timing deadlines. Full-stack programming experience delivering edge-to-cloud solutions. Experience developing for real-time operating systems and/or bare-metal environments. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of memory management and pointer manipulation. Knowledge of asymmetric and symmetric multiprocessing concepts, virtual memory, and their real-time implications. Experience developing test automation, build scripts, and rapid prototypes using Python or other scripting languages. Working knowledge of embedded cybersecurity, secure boot, cryptographic primitives, or industrial control and operational technology security standards, such as IEC 62443 or NIST SP 800-82. Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript for front-end development and C++ or Python for integration with system-level services or embedded APIs. Experience with CI/CD environments such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Familiarity with multithreaded applications and computer networking. Familiarity with Xilinx and/or Intel (Altera) FPGA devices, tools, and ecosystems, such as ModelSim, Intel Quartus, or Xilinx Vivado. Knowledge of digital logic design, including finite-state machines, pipelining, and resource optimization. Experience with high-speed and standard interfaces such as UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, PCIe, or DDR. Experience developing testbenches and performing functional verification. Knowledge of clock-domain crossing techniques and metastability mitigation. Experience with FPGA or ASIC design using Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL. Experience with the FPGA design flow, including simulation, synthesis, place and route, static timing analysis, and timing closure. title: Full Stack Engineer - Agentic Platforms
jd_text: About GlobalFoundries: GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com. Summary of Role: GlobalFoundries is building the next generation of enterprise AI and agentic workflows through the CIO FDE Office. The Full Stack Engineer will partner with business teams, Redpanda FDE engineers, enterprise architects, and application owners to rapidly design, prototype, integrate, and operationalize AI-powered solutions. This role combines application development, API engineering, AI/agent development, cloud integration, data orchestration, and user experience design. The engineer will be part of a small, high-impact pod responsible for incubating new agentic use cases and moving successful solutions into production with appropriate security, observability, governance, and cost controls. Essential Responsibilities: 1. Agent and AI Solution Development Design, build, and deploy enterprise AI agents using Redpanda ADP and related agent frameworks. Develop agent workflows supporting ServiceNow, Workday, Supply Chain, HR, IT Operations, and future enterprise use cases. Configure prompts, tools, MCP integrations, multi-agent workflows, and orchestration patterns. Assist with evaluation, testing, observability, telemetry, and operational readiness of deployed agents. 2. Full Stack Application Development Build modern web applications, dashboards, and user experiences supporting agentic workflows. Develop front-end solutions using modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or similar technologies. Build backend services, APIs, middleware, and event-driven integrations. Create reusable application components that accelerate future agent deployments. 3. API and Enterprise Integration Engineering Design and implement integrations with Enterprise systems working with Application and Integration team Build and maintain MCPs, connectors, API wrappers, and service integrations. Support authentication and authorization patterns including Entra ID, OBO, app registrations, token brokering, and secrets management. Work with application owners to assess API readiness, integration feasibility, and production support considerations. 4. Cloud and Platform Engineering Develop solutions on AWS-based environments including ADP BYOC deployments. Support containerized workloads, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and deployment automation. Collaborate with platform, cloud, network, and security teams on scalability and production readiness. Contribute to reference deployment patterns for agentic workloads and enterprise integrations. 5. Agentic Use Case Incubation Participate in workshops with business stakeholders to identify automation opportunities. Translate business processes into agent-enabled workflows and technical implementation plans. Rapidly prototype, demo, refine, and industrialize solutions. Contribute reusable patterns, standards, and development methodology across GF. 6. Collaboration and Technical Leadership Work alongside Redpanda FDE engineers, GF business SMEs, enterprise architects, and application teams. Mentor NCG resources and junior engineers within the pod. Contribute to architecture decisions, build standards, and reference implementations. Help scale the CIO FDE Office operating model across multiple business domains. Other Responsibilities: Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. Required Qualifications: Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. 7+ years of software engineering experience. Experience developing REST APIs and enterprise integrations. Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar languages. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Understanding of authentication, authorization, APIs, and enterprise security patterns. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AI agents, MCP servers, LLM platforms, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph, CrewAI, or Redpanda ADP. Experience with Kafka, Redpanda, event-driven architectures, streaming data, or orchestration platforms. Experience integrating with ServiceNow APIs, Workday APIs, SAP APIs, or Microsoft Graph. Experience creating production-grade AI applications, workflow automation, or agentic systems. Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving incubation environments where requirements evolve through prototyping. Success Measures - First 12 Months Deliver production-ready agentic solutions for priority CIO FDE Office use cases. Build reusable MCPs and API integration assets that reduce delivery time for future use cases. Establish repeatable engineering patterns for agent design, testing, deployment, observability, and cost awareness. Support deployments across HR, IT, Supply Chain, and additional business domains. Improve GF capability to move emerging technology from idea to production without surprises in risk, security, or cost. Core Competencies Engineering Capability Full stack development, API engineering, integration patterns, cloud services, CI/CD, observability Builds reusable components and reference implementations Enterprise Fluency Understands GF systems of record, security, identity, governance, and production support requirements Partners effectively with business SMEs and application owners Agentic Mindset Can translate workflows into AI agents, MCPs, prompts, tools, controls, and operational runbooks Balances speed of incubation with production-grade safety and cost control Expected Salary Range $104,000.00 - $175,000.00 The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location. title: Business Analyst
jd_text: Planning & Performance Business Analyst, Conferences As Gartner Conferences continues to grow and expand its portfolio, we are strengthening our Planning & Performance team to support the increasing analytical needs of the business. The Planning & Performance Business Analyst will partner with leaders across the Conferences organization to deliver data-driven insights, performance analysis, forecasting, and business recommendations that support growth and operational excellence. This role combines analytical rigor, business acumen, and modern technology tools to enhance decision-making across the portfolio. Responsibilities: Support the annual budgeting process and monthly forecasting cycles across the Conferences portfolio. Manage and enhance weekly and monthly operational reporting and KPI tracking. Produce actionable business insights and performance recommendations through analysis of commercial, operational, marketing, and financial data. Identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance drivers, and communicate findings to business leaders in a clear and compelling manner. Prepare executive-level analytics, presentations, and business reviews for senior leadership. Develop and maintain analytical models to support short- and long-term planning, forecasting, and scenario analysis. Validate and analyze large operational datasets to develop meaningful KPIs and improve business decision-making. Conduct root cause analyses to understand performance variances and recommend corrective actions. Partner with stakeholders across the Conferences business to translate business questions into analytical frameworks and data-driven solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams on strategic initiatives and business improvement projects. Support revenue, marketing, and operational budget reporting requirements. Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and analytical capabilities. Leverage AI-enabled tools and emerging analytics technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and uncover deeper business insights. Respond to ad hoc business analysis and operational data requests. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable business recommendations. Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify trends, and communicate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, including experience developing executive-ready materials. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Point and Power BI, including data modeling and data visualization. We’re the leader in our industry, achieving double-digit growth by helping clients make the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else. Gartner Executive Finance Partners serve as trusted advisors to our members (clients) who are CFOs from Global 1000 organizations and government agencies. About this role: We are specifically looking for a current or prior Federal Government CFO to join the team and provide their expertise and guidance to a portfolio of members operating in the same space. The Executive Finance Partner’s (EFP) role is to engage each member-client, and to help them identify key initiatives to achieve specific enterprise goals. Partnering with the member can include activities such as: defining, developing, coaching and/or critiquing strategies; helping develop and/or transform their organizations; assisting/advising with the development and execution of vision & strategy; aggregating and delivering Gartner research insights on key initiatives, priorities, and implementations; and in general, becoming a trusted advisor for the client CFO. With the support of their Executive Partner, our clients are able to achieve their goals quicker and more cost effectively and with a higher assurance of success. What you’ll do: Relationship Management The Executive Partner manages a portfolio of senior executive member relationships and participates in account planning with Senior Client Managers and Senior Account Executives. These three roles collectively and individually have responsibility for each assigned account. The Executive Partner participates in all phases of the member lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review and renewal. The Executive Partner conducts monthly consultations with the CFO client, brings the power of Gartner’s service, research and advisory to each client, conducts workshops for the client member, leads CFO activities at the annual Gartner Finance Executive Conference and leads CFO breakout sessions during annual Finance Forums. Program Delivery Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing member needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Gartner Sales strategy and Gartner Finance product deliverables. Work with members across the Federal Government to further their levels of Finance maturity through delivery of research, peer networking, and coaching. Critique client strategies, guide clients in building their organizations, and assist in developing Finance strategies, establishing priorities, and planning for implementation around key Finance initiatives. Establish and maintain working relationships with various internal groups to create a comprehensive, well designed sustainable set of key deliverables for clients (including targeted research, personal coaching sessions, scripted analyst sessions, involvement with appropriate events, etc.) Direct and facilitate member peer group calls and/or meetings Service, Sales and Marketing Support The Executive Partner is responsible for member retention and for contributing toward growth in the region through direct support of Gartner Finance in prospect cultivation, account plan development and value demonstration activities Virtual and in- person interactions The Executive Partner is responsible for hosting and /or participating in periodic virtual or in-person member activities, including workshops, research analyst engagements (where appropriate), round-tables and webinars (in collaboration with Gartner Research) Research Support The Executive Partner supports research activities, such as facilitating member participation in research studies or case panels. The Executive Partner will be aligned with and leverage Gartner research positions and initiatives as well as provide feedback from the member base to the research organization. The Executive Partner works with research analysts to develop and deliver CFO relevant research. Content Development and Management Participate in presentations, panels and workshops Participate in relevant research communities to keep topic area knowledge current and share member experiences with analysts Facilitate member interaction and collaboration through the Sales community portal and assisted member connections Lead and participate in local events and roundtables What you’ll need: Subject Matter Expertise The Executive MUST be a Federal Government CFO (current or former) with demonstrated topic knowledge in developing and delivering overall Financial strategy, execution and performance improvement. In addition, to work closely with Sales to vet and close “new’ CFO business. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading research and advisory company. We help business leaders across all major functions in every industry and enterprise size with the objective insights they need to make the right decisions. Our comprehensive suite of services delivers strategic advice and proven best practices to help clients succeed in their mission-critical priorities. Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, USA, and has more than 13,000 associates serving clients in 11,000 enterprises in 100 countries. For more information, visit gartner.com. title: GE Turboshaft Engines (T700) - Depot Subject Matter Expert Shop Floor (w/m/x)
jd_text: Job Description Summary Depot Subject Matter Expert provides depot-level technical expertise for T700/CT7 engine maintenance, repair, inspection, assembly/disassembly, troubleshooting, and test activities. This role supports both hands-on shop execution and quality/engineering-focused evaluation of maintenance activities, ensuring work is performed in accordance with technical directives, approved procedures, and operational requirements. This role also helps develop workforce capability by coaching and training customer personnel on quality systems, supporting documentation, workstation development, heavy machine operation, and technical discipline. Job Description Role Overview GE Aerospace is seeking a T700/CT7 (Turboshaft) Depot Subject Matter Expert - Shop Floor to support hands-on depot execution for T700/CT7 engines, modules, and components. This role is ideal for a practical engine maintenance professional who brings deep shop knowledge, strong technician instincts, and a commitment to safe, disciplined execution. You will help drive daily maintenance activity across inspection, disassembly, assembly, tooling, support equipment, and test stand support while coaching personnel and helping the team solve issues quickly and effectively. This role is full time, on-site at customer facility located in Deblin, Poland. Key Responsibilities · Support depot maintenance execution for T700-GE-701C/D, CT7-2E1 and CT7-8E engines, modules, and components across inspection, disassembly, assembly, repair support, and final preparation activities. · Assist with removal, installation, inspection, repairs, and modifications using approved maintenance procedures and sound workmanship practices. · Train the customer and support engine and module disassembly and assembly activities with focus on task discipline, cleanliness, hardware accountability, and safe execution. · Support movement, handling, preservation, storage, and transportation preparation of engines and engine modules as required by depot operations. · Assist with installation and removal of engines on test stands and support engine operation, evaluation, and testing activities with the appropriate customer teams. · Inspect, maintain, and train customer on engine ground support equipment and related support equipment needed for maintenance execution. · Assist in selection and use of special tools, hand tools, fixtures, and test equipment correctly, and help reinforce proper use, care, and readiness of shop assets. · Provide hands-on coaching and on-the-job training to customer personnel to strengthen technician capability and execution consistency. · Help identify and resolve shop floor issues involving tooling, equipment readiness, workflow interruptions, or technical execution barriers. · Work closely with GE internal and customer operations, quality, and engineering teams to maintain safe, efficient, and compliant maintenance flow. Basic Qualifications · Demonstrated experience in T700/CT7 engine maintenance, depot operations, or closely related turboshaft engine shop activity. · Hands-on experience with engine or module inspection, assembly, disassembly, and maintenance execution in a controlled shop environment. · Ability to interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, and maintenance instructions and apply them accurately on the shop floor. · Experience supporting troubleshooting, repair activity, or maintenance task completion on turbine engines or related systems. · Experience using tooling, fixtures, support equipment, and test equipment relevant to engine depot maintenance and handling activity. · Working knowledge of safe work practices, tool control, hardware accountability, and procedural compliance in maintenance operations. · Ability to provide effective on-the-job training, technician coaching, and practical execution guidance. Preferred Qualifications · Experience supporting shop operations, production flow, military or depot sustainment programs, or complex maintenance environments utilizing FLIGHT DECK or similar lean operating system. · Background in test operations, equipment readiness, engine handling, or support equipment maintenance. · Demonstrated tooling discipline and ability to reinforce efficient, organized, and repeatable work practices. · Experience working within matrix operations, quality, engineering, and support functions to remove barriers and solve issues quickly. · Ability to contribute to continuous improvement, daily execution rhythm, and practical shop floor problem solving. · Experience leading by example in workmanship, safe execution, technician development, and task accountability. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means helping the customer depot team execute hands-on engine maintenance with strong safety, quality, and workflow discipline. You will bring practical shop leadership, support reliable use of tools and equipment, coach technicians in the moment, and help keep engine and module work moving efficiently from receiving, inspection, and teardown through test and final preparation. Customer will take away a continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to properly utilize and implement FLIGHT DECK tools in response to shop identified concerns. title: HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor (all genders)
jd_text: Job Description Summary Job Description Join GE Vernova and help shape the future of energy. At GE Vernova Grid Solutions , we are advancing the energy transition by delivering innovative technologies and large-scale projects that strengthen and modernize power grids. As our HVDC business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor (all genders) to join our Construction & Commissioning team in Central Europe. In this role, you will supervise the installation of HVDC valves, valve cooling systems and high-voltage primary equipment on our large-scale HVDC projects, ensuring safe, high-quality and timely execution by our installation subcontractors. This is a site-based position with functional leadership responsibilities, without direct reports. Your Impact Installation Supervision & Coordination Supervise the mechanical and electrical installation of HVDC valves, valve cooling systems and high-voltage primary equipment performed by subcontractors. Coordinate daily installation activities with site management, engineering teams, suppliers and installation partners. Monitor installation progress, identify potential delays and support corrective actions to keep activities on schedule. Provide technical guidance to subcontractors and resolve installation-related issues in collaboration with internal experts. Ensure that installation teams follow approved technical documentation, drawings and procedures. Quality & EHS Ensure that all installation activities comply with applicable health, safety and environmental (EHS) requirements. Conduct inspections in accordance with Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) and verify installation quality against project specifications. Review installation documentation, inspection records, test reports and as-built drawings. Coordinate with internal valve manufacturing teams to ensure the availability and correct use of technical documentation. Promote a strong safety culture, proactively identify risks and stop unsafe activities when necessary. What You Bring Technical qualification in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in electrical or mechanical installation works. Severak years of experience in installation supervision, site management or construction activities within large-scale electrical or industrial projects. Experience with high-voltage equipment, substations, GIS, AIS, FACTS or HVDC projects is highly desirable. Good understanding of mechanical and electrical installation processes, technical drawings, quality inspections and site safety requirements. Experience coordinating subcontractors and working with multidisciplinary site teams. Strong communication, problem-solving and organizational skills, with a proactive and hands-on approach. Good command of English, both written and spoken. Willingness to work on project construction sites and travel or relocate temporarily according to project requirements. What We Offer Impactful Projects: Contribute to major HVDC projects supporting the energy transition and strengthening Europe's power grid. Professional Development: Grow your technical expertise through challenging projects, training and collaboration with experienced specialists. International Environment: Work alongside diverse teams and experts across our global Grid Solutions organization. Ownership & Collaboration: Take responsibility for your area of expertise within a supportive and solution-oriented team. Competitive Rewards: Attractive compensation and corporate benefits within a growing global energy technology business. Ready to make an impact? Join GE Vernova and help build the power grids of tomorrow. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No #LI-Remote - This is a remote position

title: Lead Generator Diagnostic and Robotics Specialist
jd_text: Job Description Summary The Lead Generator Diagnostics and Robotics Specialist – Responsible for providing technical leadership and executing complex electro-mechanical testing (EMT), robotic-assisted inspections, generator diagnostics, and specialized generator monitoring services. This role focuses on Stator Leak Monitoring Systems (SLMS), Rotational Velocity Method (RVM) torsional testing, and the deployment of advanced robotic platforms for internal generator assessments. Operating in fossil and nuclear power stations worldwide, this role involves the installation, calibration, and maintenance of advanced instrumentation, as well as the interpretation of technical data to assess the operational health of turbine-generator equipment. The incumbent serves as a subject matter expert (SME), integrating diagnostic solutions to enhance safety, data accuracy, and operational efficiency, while ensuring all field operations adhere to safety, quality, and schedule commitments. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Technical Execution & Field Operations: Conduct or direct critical generator tests, including SLMS commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Execute RVM torsional vibration measurements, including probe installation, data acquisition, and diagnostic analysis. Deploy and operate robotic inspection systems for internal generator assessments, integrating robotic data outputs with traditional EMT data for comprehensive diagnostic reporting. Commercial Responsibilities: Work directly with Regional Commercial Managers, Service Managers, and Sales Managers to ensure requested workscopes and technical specifications—including robotic service offerings—are reviewed and that I&LES can meet all customer/contract requirements. Perform in-depth research, including review of inspection reports and historical data, and interpret drawings to translate information into accurate inspection requirements. Provide engineering support teams with technical data and knowledge of I&LES service offerings. Work with Product Services to develop enhancements, evaluate new robotic technologies, and streamline procedures for the I&LES commercial process. Coordinate proposal development to ensure customer-required schedule dates are met and quality proposals are issued. Project Management & Administration: Manage costing and proposal development within Workflows, Excel, Access, and SalesForce. Maintain field data, robotic diagnostic logs, and project documentation. Technical Leadership: Provide onsite leadership, mentoring, and training for less experienced personnel. Create technical work instructions and procedures for both traditional EMT and robotic-assisted testing. Lead quality reviews across multiple inspection technologies. Customer Interface: Communicate effectively with internal engineering teams, site representatives, and external customers during planning, execution, and post-job meetings. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college; OR an associate's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, or Non-Destructive Technology (or equivalent) with at least 5 years of relevant field experience. Technical Expertise: Expertise in generator design principles, generator operation, and electro-mechanical testing. Advanced knowledge in the installation/maintenance of generator monitoring systems (e.g., SLMS, partial discharge (PD), shorted turn, vibration sensors, accelerometers, proximity probes, flow sensors). Proficiency in torsional vibration measurement techniques (e.g., rotary encoders, magnetic pickups, optical sensors) and deployment of remote inspection tools, automated crawlers, or robotic diagnostic platforms. Strong analytical skills regarding rotational velocity and sensor-driven data. Professional Skills: Ability to work well within a short time cycle and high-pressure environments. Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Strong verbal and written communication skills; demonstrated ability to organize and train team members. Operational Requirements: High Travel: Willingness to travel globally on short notice and for extended periods (70% travel during outage seasons). Flexibility: Willingness and ability to work flexible hours as required by project schedules. Software Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project Scheduler), Modal Analysis Software, and other applicable data acquisition or robotic interface systems. Desired Characteristics Ability to handle multiple projects concurrently and be very results-oriented. MS in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related discipline. Experience in the use or development of telemetry-based measurement systems. Acoustic, vibration, or mechanical oscillation measurement experience with steam turbine, gas turbine, or generator technology. Proven project management experience executing measurement technology development. Direct experience with field-ready robotic inspection systems in power generation environments. Commitment to teamwork, team success, and strong customer focus. title: Lead P&C Engineer
jd_text: Job Description Summary The Lead Protection & Control Engineer works on T&D substations for AC, HVDC and FACTS projects with designers, peer engineers & leaders. The engineer is responsible to define, design, coordinate all technical aspects of HV / EHV substation protection & control and oversee technical plant integration and optimization at project level considering safety, quality, schedule and cost criteria. The engineer should have great attention to detail with a can-do attitude & customer responsiveness. The Lead Protection & Control Engineer may be identified as project engineer for small to medium size project, which are highly secondary engineering focused. The engineer shall continuously update themselves with new technology and have a mindset of continuous learning, consistent with grid transition needs. Responsible for departmental operations planning/execution or is focused on execution of professional activities within a technical discipline. Functions with some autonomy but guided by established policies or review of end results. Job Description Essential Responsibilities: Ultimately be responsible for design of protection schemes for all kinds of T&D substations, Data Centers, Industrial, BESS applications including one-lines, three-lines, AC / DC schematics, and relay settings. Lead a local or remote design team to develop panel and interconnect wiring as well as panel layouts and elevations Evaluate the interoperability, control features, and communication / protocol aspects of IED’s serving as protection relays to provide an integrated solution including SCADA, Cyber Security and Telecom needs. Be familiar with IEC 61850 process and system bus architecture and its implementation for substations Coordinate with and provide technical assistance to SCADA engineers, substation physical engineers, and control design staff in order to fully develop system integration of protection, control, and monitoring systems. Work with team to meet project specifications, cost control, and schedule objectives Interface with internal and external team members such as Lead engineers, Project Engineers, Electrical Designers, Physical Designers, Draftsmen, Project managers, Sourcing, and support organizations Review power system load flow studies, fault studies, relay setting coordination, and transient studies performed by other agencies Train end-users on the theory, operational use, and maintenance of integrated protection and control systems Lead or support factory acceptance testing and site testing & commissioning Develop outage, cut-over, and testing procedures Define processes, procedures, perform RCA's (Root Cause Analysis), perform corrective actions, and validate process control. Support quality initiatives including aspects of ISO9002 Work on development of proposals including: writing and/or reviewing technical specifications, estimating design man-hours and materials, supporting sourcing for vendor quotations, and the development of clarifications and exceptions as well as technical responses and performing technical validation. Demonstrate leadership behaviors of acting with humility, lead with transparency and deliver with focus Requirements: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar degree from an accredited university. Minimum 7 years’ experience in engineering. Minimum 5 years’ experience in protection and controls engineering for substations or power generation. Ability and willingness to travel up to 20% of the time, including international, for meetings and on-site commissioning tests for customer installations and comply with all relevant company travel and tax policies Desired Characteristics: P.E. License or EIT with willingness to pursue and acquire P.E certification or P.Eng or willingness to acquire certification. Extensive experience in protective relaying coordination and practices. Good understanding of circuit breakers, fuses, circuit switchers, transformers, shunt reactors, cap banks, harmonic filters, HVDC and FACTS systems used in the control of power flow, detection and isolation of power system faults. Fluent in English. Strong influencing and relationship building skills. Demonstrated presentation skills and ability to succinctly communicate complex messages. Experience in technical problem solving. Mastering of sec engineering discipline (process, tools and technical aspects) Demonstrates ownership and accountability, judgment and decision making and has passion for the functional role. title: OSR- Steam Turbine Blader / Machinist
jd_text: Job Description Summary The On-Site Repair (OSR) Steam Turbine Blader and Machinist Apprentice will serve as-on the-job assistant and trainee, in the various repairs on rotating steam turbine blades and machining work of steam turbines components and machining repair work on gas turbine components. A Steam Turbine Blader technician will be required to perform complicated operations involving dismantling, assembling, reassembling, and repairing on Power Generation Turbines. The Blader will be responsible for re-blade, repair, welding and assembly Turbine components (ST rotors, diaphragms, casings, valves). As well as fulfilling necessary training required. This role requires recurrent travel by both air and road to and from site locations throughout Mexico and the Latin America Countries. Job Description Previous experience in manufacturing, repair, machining operations with conventional equipment and CNC equipment (desired), mechanical work experience on turbomachinery components. Operation of various machine tools involving close tolerance work and intricate setups. Operation of various hand tools to complete assignments. Ability to read and decipher prints/drawings. ST Blader will perform related duties as assigned and may direct others. Conducts him/herself in a professional manner at all times and is willing to lead by example and teamwork. Demonstrates strong EHS values, consistently participates in Safety Meetings, Safety Calls and EHS Observations Program. Ability and willingness to travel to customer sites on short notice, both domestically and internationally, as required undefined ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS High School Diploma with a minimum of 2 years classroom or on the job Machinist experience. Must possess a valid driver's license Possess a valid passport or Eligibility for immigration documents (passport and work visas/permits) Ability and willingness to work rotating shifts Ability and willingness to climb ladders and stairs as required Ability and willingness to walk/stand for up to 12 hours as required Ability and willingness to lift to 25 kilograms as required Ability to pass a drug test Ability to pass a background check and obtain nuclear clearance Ability and willingness to complete a physical and other evaluations for hearing and respirator use upon hire and annually thereafter Ability to incorporate teamwork into daily operating and safety work tasks Ability to use and read measurement devices such as inside/outside micrometers and dial calipers/indicators. title: OT Cyber Security SME - ERCIS (M/F/D)
jd_text: Job Description Summary Job Description Summary The Grid Automation (GA) Cybersecurity SME - ERCIS has the mission to contribute to GA growth by assisting in the cybersecurity sales process (including demos and bid responses), as well as the execution and delivery of various cybersecurity offerings at the customer’s locations on an as-needed basis. Le/La Responsable Cybersécurité de Grid Automation (GA) - ERCIS a pour mission de contribuer à la croissance de GA en participant au processus de vente de produits de cybersécurité (y compris les démonstrations et les réponses aux offres), ainsi qu'à l'exécution et à la livraison de diverses offres de cybersécurité sur les sites clients en fonction des besoins. Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team. Has significant input into priorities. Guided by professional practices and policies that are shaped by the role. The role has moderate autonomy, requiring high levels of operational judgment. Job Description Job Description ​ MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES: Own the cybersecurity expertise (subject matter expert) for Grid Automation within a given territory / region. Assist the Sales Operations teams in responding to demo requests, RFPs, and other Bid/Tender requests. Stay connected with the market dynamics, engage with GA customers to understand their cybersecurity needs / pain-points, and translate them into new cybersecurity sales opportunities. Present the Grid Automation cybersecurity offerings to customers in a variety of locations – including trade shows and events. Develop sophisticated cybersecurity designs for customer environments. Understand competitors’ offerings, industry trends, customers’ behavior. Be available to be “hands-on” at customer sites to assist in the design, configuration, and installation of a variety of cybersecurity offerings. Promote the GA cybersecurity offerings with utility and industrial customers and the GA sales organization. Drive productive interactions with GA region teams, other GA Product Managers, R&D and product development, Technical Application Engineering, and Commercial teams. Develop, coach, and mentor the regional cybersecurity delivery teams (customer engineers) to strengthen their overall technical and business capabilities. Develop and conduct training on a variety of cybersecurity topics for the Regions and GA staff as needed. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS : Apporter toute son expertise en cybersécurité (être l’expert en la matière) pour l'automatisation des réseaux dans un territoire/une région donnée ; Aider les équipes des opérations commerciales à répondre aux demandes de démonstration, aux appels d'offres et à d'autres demandes d'enchère/d'appel d'offres. Rester connecté/e à la dynamique du marché, communiquer avec les clients de GA pour comprendre leurs besoins et leurs problèmes en matière de cybersécurité, et les traduire en nouvelles opportunités de vente dans le domaine de la cybersécurité ; Présenter les offres de cybersécurité de GA aux clients présents dans différentes localisations et notamment lors de salons professionnels et d'événements. Développer des conceptions en matière de cybersécurité sophistiquées pour les environnements des clients ; Comprendre les offres des concurrents, les tendances du secteur et le comportement des clients ; Etre disponible pour aller sur le terrain, sur les sites clients, afin de les aider à concevoir, à configurer et à installer diverses solutions de cybersécurité ; Promouvoir les offres de cybersécurité de GA auprès des clients des secteurs des services publics et industriels et de l'organisation commerciale de GA ; Favoriser des interactions productives avec les équipes de la région GA, les chefs de produit, les équipes R&D et développement de produits, l'ingénierie des applications techniques et les équipes comerciales ; Développer, coacher et accompagner les équipes régionales de livraison (ingénieurs clients) afin de renforcer leurs capacités techniques et commerciales globales. Élaborer et organiser des formations sur divers sujets liés à la cybersécurité pour les régions et le personnel de GA en fonction des besoins. QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering or equivalent work experience. Business Administration degree would be an asset ( e.g., MBA). At least some years’ real-world experience in OT cybersecurity versus IT cybersecurity. At least some years’ experience in the energy sector, especially in the industrial protection and control / automation, transmission, distribution, or service fields. Hands-on knowledge of many types of cybersecurity products, solutions, and services and how to sell them for customer adoption. Experience operating as a cybersecurity sales coach, trainer, and overlay (to up-level an uneducated sales organization to promote and sell a variety of cybersecurity offerings) – making a huge impact on growth. At least some years’ experience working with a variety of different types of Channel Partners. Demonstrated experience with Linux, and Microsoft Windows operating systems including user account management, security / system hardening & device control, and patch management. Familiarity with LDAP, RADIUS, TLS, SSH, SFTP, RSA, HTTPS, NERC-CIP, NIST, IEC62443, IEC62351 standards, cyber asset protection regulations and standards, and communication protocols like IEC61850, DNP, IEC60870-5-104 – affecting the utilities industry. Experience with threat modeling techniques and tools. Strong customer service mindset. Experience with operating systems like Microsoft Windows, Linux, and VxWorks. Good writing and oral communication skills. Experience with Microsoft 365 applications ( e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, and Word), Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft SharePoint. Experience with Box, OneDrive, Smartsheet, Adobe, Tableau, and SFDC. Willingness and the ability to participate in video meetings that occasionally happen early in the morning, or later in the evening. Willingness and ability to travel within Europe - approximately 20% - 50%. QUALIFICATIONS/EXIGENCES : Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, en génie électrique ou en génie informatique ou expérience professionnelle équivalente Un diplôme en administration des affaires serait un atout (ex. MBA) A minima quelques années d'expérience concrète en matière de cybersécurité OT par rapport à la cybersécurité informatique A minima quelques années d'expérience dans le secteur de l'énergie, notamment dans les domaines de la protection industrielle et du contrôle/automatisation, de la transmission, de la distribution ou des services Connaissance pratique de nombreux types de produits, de solutions et de services de cybersécurité et de la manière de les vendre pour qu'ils soient adoptés par les clients Expérience en tant que Coach commercial, formateur/trice et superviseur en cybersécurité (pour développer une organisation commerciale afin de promouvoir et de vendre une variété d'offres de cybersécurité), pour avoir un impact considérable sur la croissance. A minima quelques années d'expérience de travail en collaboration avec différents types de partenaires de distribution. Expérience démontrée avec les systèmes d'exploitation Linux et Microsoft Windows, y compris la gestion des comptes utilisateurs, le renforcement de la sécurité/du système et le contrôle des appareils, ainsi que la gestion des correctifs. Connaissance des normes LDAP, RADIUS, TLS, SSH, SFTP, RSA, HTTPS, NERC-CIP, NIST, IEC62443, IEC62351, des réglementations et normes de protection des cyberactifs et des protocoles de communication tels que IEC61850, DNP, IEC60870-5-104, qui ont une incidence sur le secteur des services publics. Expérience des techniques et des outils de modélisation des menaces. Solide état d'esprit en matière de service client. Expérience avec des systèmes d'exploitation tels que Microsoft Windows, Linux et VxWorks. Bonnes compétences en rédaction et en communication orale. Expérience avec les applications Microsoft 365 (par exemple, Excel, PowerPoint et Word), Microsoft Teams et Microsoft SharePoint). Expérience avec Box, OneDrive, Smartsheet, Adobe, Tableau et SFDC. Volonté et capacité à participer à des réunions vidéo qui ont parfois lieu tôt le matin ou tard dans la soirée. Volonté et capacité de voyager en Europe : environ 20 % à 50 %. DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS: Ability to work comfortably in a global organization with people from many different cultures and backgrounds. Bi-lingual or multilingual is highly desired, and a huge plus. Ability to interface with, and influence all levels of the customer’s organization, as well as other internal GE Vernova functions, and be able to converse in detail about a broad amount of cybersecurity topics. Has a good handle on where the cybersecurity industry is headed, when, and why. Strong account management, sales, and consulting presence. Strong customer advisory (trusted advisor) and advocacy skills. Strong business acumen and commercial savvy. Strong customer service mindset – customer first mentality. Strong business and financial acumen and operating background. Solid oral and written communication and training skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Strong team player with a desire to go the extra mile when needed. CARACTÉRISTIQUES SOUHAITÉES : Capacité à travailler confortablement dans une organisation mondiale composée de personnes de cultures et d'horizons différents. Le bilinguisme ou le multilinguisme est fortement souhaité, c'est un avantage considérable. Capacité à interagir avec tous les niveaux de l'organisation du client, ainsi qu'avec d'autres fonctions internes de GE Vernova, et à interagir en détail sur un large éventail de sujets liés à la cybersécurité. Une bonne compréhension du secteur de la cybersécurité, comment le gérer, quand et pourquoi. Solides compétence en matière de gestion des comptes, des ventes et de conseil. Solides compétences en matière de conseil à la clientèle (conseiller de confiance) et de plaidoyer. Sens aigu des affaires Un solide état d'esprit en matière de service à la clientèle clientèle, priorité client Solide sens des affaires, des finances et expérience opérationnelle. Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite Compétences dans la formation Solides compétences interpersonnelles et de leadership Solide esprit d'équipe avec l’envie de se dépasser lorsque nécessaire Why we come to work: At GE Renewable Energy, our engineers are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition. Pourquoi nous venons travailler : Chez GE Renewable Energy, nos Ingénieur/es sont toujours prêt/es à relever les défis, et nous sommes toujours déterminés à trouver la meilleure solution. Nos projets sont uniques et intéressants, et vous devrez adopter une approche positive et axée sur les solutions pour faire de votre mieux. Entouré/e de collègues dévoués et loyaux, si vous osez apporter votre ingéniosité et votre désir d'avoir un impact, vous serez exposé/e à des projets diversifiés et révolutionnaires qui vous permettront véritablement de jouer votre rôle dans la transition énergétique What we offer: A key role in a dynamic, international working environment with a large degree of flexibility of work agreements Competitive benefits, and great development opportunities - including private health insurance. Des avantages compétitifs et de grandes opportunités de développement, y compris une assurance maladie privée. title: Sales Leader Poland/ Baltics & Eastern Europe - Onshore Wind
jd_text: Job Description Summary At GE Vernova, we are accelerating the energy transition by electrifying the world while advancing decarbonization. As a global energy company spanning Power, Wind, and Electrification, we help customers around the world deliver reliable, affordable, and more sustainable energy. As a Senior Sales Leader, you will play a key role in your region in driving business growth and building strategic customer partnerships across a dynamic and evolving energy landscape. Operating within a global organization with a presence on six continents and an expanding portfolio of technologies and services, you will help shape commercial strategies that enable customers to meet their energy and sustainability goals. Join us and be part of a team that is delivering the energy systems of today while helping create a more sustainable future for generations to come. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities: Responsible for onshore wind turbine sales in Poland, the Baltics, and Eastern Europe Create close working relationships with all key stakeholders at assigned accounts across the Region and develop a thorough understanding of their project strategies and needs. Provide commercial and technical support to assigned accounts with their project strategy. Ensure GE Vernova’s Onshore Wind products and services have a favourable consideration in all assigned or newly created accounts’ wind projects. Identify, develop, and close sales opportunities within assigned accounts. Identify, understand, and communicate to the Onshore Wind management, customer requirements from both project-specific and their business in general. Work effectively in a team environment with Commercial Operations, Technical Operations, and Engineering, Finance, and Project Management to ensure the most efficient use of all resources. Use judgment to make decisions or solve complex tasks or problems within projects, product lines, markets, sales processes etc. Utilize multiple internal and available external sources outside of own function to arrive at decisions. Leverage technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations. Be accountable for orders, pricing/profitability, risk, terms & conditions, and customer satisfaction. Manage the Inquiry to Order ("ITO") process for assigned accounts. Maintain data quality and accuracy of current project(s), opportunities, and customer information in the sales database system. Participate in and support trade shows, conferences, and other related business events. Key measurements will include: Accountability of business operation plan relative to assigned markets: Region Orders, Margins, and Cash Operating Plan. Creating and maintaining pipeline. Performance to Goals & Objectives (developed in cooperation with Region Sales Leader). Sales Database accuracy and Data Quality. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering related to energy projects, Finance, and/or an advanced business degree with applicable renewable industry experience. Extensive experience and a proven track record of relevant sales and business development achievements in the wind power industry. Practical understanding of current/emerging requirements of the power generation markets and customer financial drivers and needs. Strong communication skills and confidence with executive-level presentations. Strong interpersonal, team-building, and negotiation skills; ability to work with colleagues and customers at all levels of the organizations. Flexible for frequent travel throughout the country and region (30+) Consistent track record of meeting performance objectives. Self-starter with high energy and ability to energize others, drive change, work independently, and in the team. Fluency in Polish and English.
