title: Senior Commercial Proposal Manager - NAM
jd_text: Job Description Summary The Senior Commercial Proposal Manager drives functional and operational Commercial Intensity and Policy 5.0 rigor for assigned deal opportunities. The Senior Commercial Proposal Manager will manage the quoting, proposal generation, contract negotiation, and ITO-OTR turnover processes for all assigned deal opportunities of the assigned segment and sub-region. In this role you will be responsible for work that is less defined in scope and have the understanding and experience to execute business objectives, be involved in short-term and long-term planning and contribute to the overall business strategy. Job Description Key Responsibilities Work as a key member of the region and/or sub-region Inquiry to Order (“ITO”) team in support of achieving the region’s and/or sub-region’s commitments, orders, sales, cash, operating profit, and margin targets for the applicable segment. Working with the region and/or sub-region Sales, Operations, and functional teams, lead the ITO proposal generation and contract formation process for projects across the segment with the intent of developing winning strategies to leverage successful deal closures while ensuring compliance with established guidelines for the Policy 5.0 risk management process, the advance release process. Be responsible for effectively driving the proposal and contract ITO processes to develop scope, cost, risk, and market / value pricing strategy for an assigned deal opportunity to provide technical and commercial solutions meeting both customer and GEV’s requirements and business goals. Collaborate with the respective sales, operations, and other functional teams during the deal development and review process to ensure that all technical risk points, risk mitigation, and business risk acceptance levels are properly incorporated into the development of the opportunity scope, cost, strategy, and actual proposal / contract language Prepare and lead the Sub-Regional/Deal Team Policy 5.0 review process in co-ordination with the applicable Commercial Director, subject matter experts, approvers, and functional teams. Drive and coordinating ITO process compliance and metrics across assigned deal opportunities with special emphasis on Policy 5.0 requirements, proposal and contract completeness, timeliness, and quality, and the effectiveness and efficiency of the ITO-OTR (Inquiry To Order - Order To Remittance) handover process. Drive proposal throughput, yield, cost, efficiency, and individual productivity. Ensure process adherence to all government-contracting requirements with support from GEV legal resources. Enforce order-booking requirements and drive an improved OTR turnover process to ensure proper control of contract flow-down requirements. Be responsible for reducing cost-of-quality issues arising from inaccurate or poor scope definition, costing, or contract drafting during the ITO process and inadequate handovers during the ITO-OTR handover and advance release process for assigned deal opportunities. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering or business from an accredited university or college Minimum 8 years of experience in Power generation equipment with a focus on sales, commercial operations, engineering or execution operations Desired Characteristics Minimum 5 years of Deep Heavy Duty product knowledge and commercial experience and direct customer relationships Experience managing and communicating/presenting complex programs or projects with problem-solving abilities with all level management Commercial/sales/project related experience with complex Gas Turbine service solutions in the Power Generation and/or Energy Industry Experience within both the Multi-Year Contractual and Transactional Services businesses preferred Experience managing large complex deals with multi-functional interactions. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple individual and team responsibilities for multiple complex projects. Excellent technical and/or commercial writing and reading comprehension skills. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No #LI-Remote - This is a remote position

title: Site Manager - Electrical/Infrastructure
jd_text: Job Description Summary Are you ready to lead the infrastructure projects powering the energy transition? We are seeking a proactive Site Manager to join our Power Conversion team. In this role, you will be the technical and operational heartbeat of our industrial projects, leading field teams and ensuring the successful delivery of complex electrification systems. If you are a collaborative leader who thrives on site and takes pride in operational excellence, we invite you to help us build a more sustainable future. Job Description What you will accomplish You will be the primary point of contact for the end-to-end site lifecycle, from initial tender to final commissioning. You will: Lead Project Planning: Shape the success of our projects by coordinating site scheduling, estimating costs for installation work, and planning infrastructure requirements during the tender phase. Drive Execution: Manage the mobilization of site teams, oversee construction progress, and ensure that our "Construction Operating Rhythm" is consistently applied across all project sites. Champion Safety and Quality: Uphold our unwavering commitment to Health, Safety, and Environmental standards. You will proactively manage risks, perform quality inspections, and ensure all contractors meet our high performance and safety benchmarks. Collaborate and Communicate: Act as a bridge between design offices and site teams, ensuring data flows efficiently and that stakeholders are kept informed through accurate, timely progress reporting. Manage Field Operations: Take ownership of site budgets and staffing plans, ensuring that our technical solutions are delivered safely, on time, and to the highest standards of quality. The value you will bring You are a natural leader with a sharp eye for detail and a passion for electrical engineering. You excel in fast-paced, site-based environments where clear communication and rigorous planning are essential. Your ability to anticipate challenges, manage complex contractor relationships, and mentor team members ensures that every project not only meets its technical goals but also fosters a culture of safety and operational excellence. What you need to succeed We are looking for someone who brings significant experience in managing site operations for large-scale electrical installations. Key requirements include: Substantive experience as a Site or Construction Manager, ideally within an electrical engineering environment. Working knowledge of the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations (CDM 2015). Familiarity with the installation and commissioning of electrical equipment, such as switchgear, transformers, or rotating machines. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and project management software. Relevant safety certification, such as NEBOSH for Construction (or similar). A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel frequently to project sites across the UK and Ireland. A degree in Electrical Engineering is beneficial; however, we value significant, relevant hands-on experience just as highly. Why join us? At our Power Conversion business, we provide the electrification systems that are critical to the world’s energy, maritime, and industrial organizations. You will join a global team dedicated to decarbonization and efficiency, working on challenging projects that make a real-world difference. We offer a flexible, remote-friendly work environment and a comprehensive benefits package—including employer pension contributions, private health insurance, and life assurance—tailored to support your personal and professional needs. Ready to make an impact? Apply today to lead the projects that are shaping the future of energy. We look forward to seeing the expertise you will bring to our team.

title: Site Manager/ Bauleiter (all genders) für Umspannwerks- Projekte
jd_text: Job Description Summary Job Description GE Vernova befindet sich in einer Phase des Hyper-Wachstums. Wir skalieren unsere Teams, bauen neue Bereiche auf und heben unsere Branche auf das nächste Level. Werden Sie Teil dieser Mission! Bei GE Vernova Grid Solutions elektrifizieren wir die Welt mit fortschrittlichen Netztechnologien. Als führendes Unternehmen im Energiesektor ist es unser Ziel, den Übergang zu einem energieeffizienteren Stromnetz zu beschleunigen, um die Anforderungen von morgen zu erfüllen. Mit Fokus auf Wachstum und Nachhaltigkeit spielt GE Vernova Grid Solutions eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Integration erneuerbarer Energien in das Netz, um den Weg zur Klimaneutralität zu ebnen. Aufgrund des Wachstums unseres AC- Umspannwerks/ FACTS Bereiches suchen wir aktuell einen Site Manager/ Bauleiter für Umspannwerks- Projekte (all genders) für den Bereich „Construction & Commissioning“, um gemeinsam an dieser Energiewende mitzuwirken. Ihre Mission: Sie leiten unsere Aktivitäten auf der Baustelle in unseren 110/ 400 kV Umspannwerksprojekten. Sie sind unser Repräsentant vor Ort, sind Ansprechpartner vor Ort für unseren Kunden und koordinieren Ihr Baustellenteam sowie unsere Subunternehmer für Bau- und Montageleistungen. Als Verantwortlicher für die Baustellentätigkeiten und dessen Ausführung tragen Sie maßgeblich dazu bei, dass die Arbeiten im Umspannwerk sicher, in hoher Qualität, termingerecht und wirtschaftlich ausgeführt werden. Die Rolle ist 100 % Baustellenbasiert. Ihre Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten Mobilisierung: Koordination der Mobilisierung von Baustellenpersonal gemeinsam mit internen Abteilungen sowie mit Subunternehmern, sowie Planung der Baustelleneinrichtung Arbeitssicherheit: Planung & Koordination aller Arbeiten auf der Baustelle unter Einhaltung der geltenden Arbeitsschutz-, Umwelt- und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Arbeits- und Sicherheitsanweisungen. Prüfung von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen & Method Statements. Baustellensteuerung: Leitung aller Baustellenaktivitäten einschließlich der Führung der Subunternehmer, um für einen reibungslosen Ablauf auf der Baustelle zu sorgen. Kommunikation: Ansprechpartner für unseren Kunden sowie Leitung der Baubesprechungen. Kontrolle & Reporting: Überwachung von Qualität, Kosten und Terminen während der Bauausführung und entsprechendes Reporting an die Projektleitung. Chancen & Risiken: Identifizierung und Management von Risiken und Chancen in Bezug auf Montageaktivitäten and entsprechendes Reporting an die Projektleitung. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich der Elektrotechnik mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung, idealerweise Weiterbildung zum Techniker/ Meister. Erfahrung als Bauleiter in Umspannwerksprojekten oder vergleichbaren Projekten, z.B. Oil & Gas, Kraftwerke, oder in der Montage von Hochspannungskomponenten wünschenswert Starkes Bewusstsein für Gesundheit und Sicherheit (EHS) gemäß internationalen Standards; die Fähigkeit, unsichere Arbeit zu identifizieren und zu stoppen, wird vorausgesetzt. Ausgeprägte zwischenmenschliche Kommunikations- und Führungsfähigkeiten, gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit zu klarer Berichterstattung Lean Mindset: Offen für Weiterbildungen, neue Tools und Verbesserungen Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands und der Niederlande Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil Führerschein Klasse B Warum wir bei GE Vernova arbeiten: Bei GE Vernova nehmen unsere Mitarbeitenden jede Herausforderung an – wir sind stets bestrebt, die bestmögliche Lösung zu finden. Unsere Projekte sind einzigartig und spannend, weshalb Sie einen lösungsorientierten und positiven Ansatz mitbringen sollten. Umgeben von engagierten Kollegen und der Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen, arbeiten Sie an wegweisenden Projekten, die einen echten Beitrag zur Energiewende leisten. Was wir bieten Berufliche Weiterentwicklung: Dynamisches Team, umfangreiche Ressourcen und Trainings zur Kompetenzentwicklung. Boomende Branche mit Cutting-Edge-Projekten: Mitarbeit an hochkarätigen, innovativen Projekten. Globale Perspektive: Zusammenarbeit mit einem vielfältigen, globalen Netzwerk von Branchenexperten. Kollaboratives Umfeld: Unterstützende Unternehmenskultur, die Kreativität und Teamarbeit fördert. Kultur mit Eigenverantwortung: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine stabile Karriereperspektive. Wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket sowie attraktive Unternehmensleistungen. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No #LI-Remote - This is a remote position

jd_text: Job Description Summary As a Senior Project Manager, you will take ownership for managing the full project life-cycle of our Controls Projects within the Software & Controls Solutions business. jd_text: Job Description Summary The Project EHS Manager HVDC (m/f/d) is GE Vernova’s lead Environment, Health & Safety representative on during the planning and execution on a German HVDC project team and the main HVDC contact to our customer. The role is responsible for development and driving all EHS aspects within the project scope, ensuring full compliance with applicable legal, customer, and GE Vernova requirements, and promoting a strong safety culture across the whole project, including integration of EHS aspects with our partners at the shipyards and offshore. The Project EHS Manager works in close partnership with the project leadership, the site EHS managers and the EHS roles of our consortium partners and subcontractors to prevent injuries, control risks, protect the environment, promote the health for everyone involved in the project and ensure disciplined implementation of project EHS plans, procedures, and standards. Provide visible EHS leadership and proactive support to the Project Management, consortium partners and subcontractors Build and promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS is embedded across all project activities Support the implementation of GE Vernova EHS strategy, standards and programs, Serve as the key EHS interface for customer, consortium partner and subcontractors Understand regulatory changes and trends and forecast business impacts. Perform and coordinate the delivery of EHS trainings, ensuring the competency of personnel within their scope. Support project management to implement, monitor and continuously improve the project’s EHS management and performance in line with GE Vernova requirements and applicable standards Conduct and facilitate risk assessments and hazard analyses; define, track and verify corrective and preventive actions Plan and perform EHS audits, inspections and site walks; follow up on findings and support closure in a timely manner Support the application of “Design for EHS” in projects (e.g. engineering controls, safe work methods, layout and access concepts) Promote Safety as the first priority for all actors in the project - communicating pro-actively and leading by exemplary behavior Report to EHS Functional Leader as well as project organization (dotted line) EHS Reporting, Incident Management & Learning Conduct EHS reporting in line with GE Vernova processes and timelines (KPIs, dashboards, monthly/quarterly reports) Ensure accurate and timely registration, classification and escalation of incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions in the designated EHS tools Coordinate together with the regional EHS leader and the project management team the incident investigation and reports, ensure that investigations of accidents and compliance incidents are conducted, documented, and reported as required. title: Signal Integrity Engineer
jd_text: About GlobalFoundries: GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. Introduction: We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer, Signal Integrity & Power Integrity Leader with strong experience in signal integrity, power integrity, die-package-board co-design, and system-level electrical architecture. This role requires deep expertise in high-speed interfaces, power delivery networks, advanced packaging technologies, and electrical performance optimization across silicon, package, and board domains. Key Responsibilities: Lead SI/PI strategy for custom silicon products developed by MIPS covering industrial, automotive, AI, networking, and other end-equipment applications. Drive the overall signal integrity and power integrity engagement on these products and establish methodologies, design guidelines, and signoff criteria to ensure robust system performance and first-pass silicon success. Define electrical architecture and system-level requirements in alignment with product performance, power, cost, reliability, and manufacturability goals. Drive architecture definition for package power delivery networks, high-speed interfaces, board topologies, and channel implementations while serving as the technical authority for electrical design decisions. Drive die-package-board co-design and related engineering work on interface placement, IO planning, bump assignment, floorplan optimization, package routing, board stackup definition, and power delivery implementation to achieve optimal electrical performance across the complete system. Cross-collaboration and system-level leadership working closely with SoC Design, Package Design, Board/System Design, Validation, and customers to develop compelling and differentiated solutions. Strong understanding of electrical performance challenges, package and board level tradeoffs, compliance requirements, and a proven track record in driving technology and vendor engagements. Drive system-level analysis performing and guiding signal integrity (SI), power integrity (PI), electromagnetic (EM), channel compliance, and electrical performance simulations across die, package, and board environments. Drive signoff methodologies and design closure processes across multiple engineering disciplines. Validation and characterization leadership with the ability to define validation strategies and characterization requirements for new products. Support compliance testing, simulation-to-silicon correlation, silicon bring-up, and electrical root-cause analysis while driving resolution of product performance issues. Mentorship and leadership in providing technical guidance and mentorship to engineers across the hardware engineering organization. Lead technical initiatives, establish engineering best practices, align team direction with business and product priorities, and serve as the technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) for SI/PI and electrical co-design methodologies. Customer and vendor engagement leadership to drive technical alignment, discussions, and execution with customers, package vendors, PCB vendors, OSAT partners, and ecosystem suppliers. Drive customer discussions and align both internal product and technology roadmaps while supporting electrical architecture and system-level performance requirements. Stay current with the latest trends in signal integrity, power integrity, advanced packaging, chiplets, UCIe, power delivery architectures, AI/HPC platforms, and next-generation high-speed interconnect technologies. Drive design innovation, provide technical leadership and mentoring within the hardware engineering team, and participate in internal and external technical forums. Other Responsibilities: Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. Required Qualifications: Master's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics, Electromagnetics, or a related field. Minimum 10+ years of relevant semiconductor experience in Signal Integrity, Power Integrity, Electrical Design, Package Design, System Design, or Die-Package-Board Co-Design. Minimum 5+ years of demonstrated experience leading SI/PI activities for complex SoCs, ASICs, high-speed interfaces, high-performance computing platforms, or heterogeneous systems. Strong understanding of high-speed electrical interfaces and system architectures including PCIe, Ethernet, DDR/LPDDR, SerDes, UCIe, USB, MIPI, networking, AI, and automotive platforms. Working knowledge and understanding of industry-standard EDA tools for package and board level simulations such as Cadence Sigrity, Cadence Clarity, Ansys HFSS, SIwave, Q3D, Synopsys tools, and related SI/PI analysis environments. Understanding of package and board design environments is highly desirable. Strong understanding of package technologies including Flip-Chip, FCBGA, WLCSP, wire-bond, advanced packaging technologies, interposers, chiplets, 2.5D, and 3D integration, along with manufacturing flows, yield considerations, and reliability standards especially related to Automotive applications. Excellent communication and documentation skills capable of producing clear, comprehensive requirements, architecture specifications, design methodologies, validation plans, and customer-facing technical documentation for both internal and external stakeholders. Collaborative mindset comfortable working in global, cross-disciplinary teams and engaging directly with customers, partners, OSATs, foundries, and ecosystem suppliers. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in ASIC or SoC development covering high-speed interfaces, networking, AI/ML, datacenter, automotive, mixed-signal, or HPC products is highly preferred. Experience engaging and driving package vendors, PCB vendors, OSAT partners, foundries, and ecosystem suppliers and exposure to advanced packaging roadmaps and semiconductor manufacturing ecosystems is highly preferred. Contributions to industry standards, technical conferences, patents, publications, or recognized technical leadership in signal integrity, power integrity, electrical architecture, high-speed interface design, or advanced packaging technologies are highly desired. Experience with advanced packaging technologies including chiplets, UCIe, HBM-based systems, 2.5D/3D integration, heterogeneous integration architectures, and next-generation high-bandwidth interconnect solutions is highly desirable. Experience developing and deploying enterprise-wide SI/PI methodologies, electrical signoff flows, and best practices across multiple product teams while driving performance closure across silicon, package, and board domains. jd_text: This is an individual contributor position, based remotely in North America . They will have a deep understanding of the challenges facing CFOs and Controllers when it comes to transforming the AP, AR and financial close process and a keen sense of business, AI and automation challenges facing them. Director Analysts create must-have insights for our clients through published research and client interaction. title: Deputy Director Technology Transactions
jd_text: About GlobalFoundries: GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. Technical degree in a field relevant to semiconductor manufacturing or design. title: Advanced Lead Engineer - Commercial Field Service
jd_text: Job Description Summary As an Advanced Lead Engineer – Commercial Field Service, you will get the unique opportunity to serve as the primary on-site representative for our customer and a single point of contact for key internal stakeholders before, during, and after aircraft entry into service. Job Description Key Roles & Responsibilities: Our FSEs embody our mission, embedded within the customers site, delivering exceptional service and support. Operating autonomously and remotely from GE Aerospace hubs to resolve technical challenges and drive success, directly in support of our customers’ fleets. More specifically, you will: Provide Leadership and Technical Support: Offer technical direction and assistance to the customers operation, inspections, maintenance, and repair of assigned fleets.​ Customer Advocacy: Deliver prompt, effective solutions that address customer issues and exceed their expectations, driving loyalty and long-term partnerships. Monitor and Improve Reliability: Track reliability and on-wing performance, including significant events, engine removals, delays, and cancellations. Influence airline stakeholders to implement critical reliability improvements. Enhance Maintenance Planning: Influence maintenance planning to ensure the stability of the aircraft engine fleet.​ Evaluate Maintenance Effectiveness: Review the effectiveness of maintenance actions to identify opportunities for improvement.​ Apply FLIGHT DECK: Utilize our FLIGHT DECK principles to deliver continuous improvement, identifying proactive reliability enhancements. Data Analytics and Reporting: Produce data analytics and timely reports on fleet status, program updates, events, and trends for key internal stakeholders.​ Proactive Maintenance Recommendations: Provide recommendations for proactive maintenance based on engine performance analytics.​ Required Qualifications: To be considered for this opportunity, candidates must have: A Bachelor of Engineering or technical degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED / technical certificate with at least 6 years of full-time work experience in airline operations or maintenance planning, engineering, aviation propulsion, or other related field). A minimum of 4 years of full-time working experience in airline operations or maintenance planning, engineering, aviation propulsion, or other related field Desired Characteristics: Technical expertise in aircraft engine or turbomachinery equipment Experience using software or data analytics to make informed technical decisions and to provide recommendations to the customer or other key internal stakeholders Self-directed with the ability to problem solve using sound judgement and critical thinking Ability to lead and deliver on result orientated priorities using strong project management, analytical, time management and prioritization skills Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to forge deep relations at all levels, not only with key internal stakeholders but also with the customer Passion to gain a deeper understanding of the commercial function and driving success for Aerospace with internal/external stakeholders, our customers, partners and colleagues Embody the GE Leadership Behaviors: Respect for People: As an FSE, you’ll foster a collaborative environment with our customers, building strong relationships and trust. You’ll be the technical on-site representative for GE Aerospace. Continuous Improvement: We’re committed to excellence and constantly seek ways to enhance and improve technical performance. Customer Driven: Understanding, prioritizing, and communicating the needs of our customers is at the heart of our field service team. Delivering prompt, effective solutions that exceed customer expectations, driving long-term partnerships.​ Additional Information Relocation: This position is eligible for international/domestic relocation support. Travel: Candidates should anticipate up to 25% travel per year in this role. GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness. ​ GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). title: Child Care Regional Program Specialist
jd_text: Job Family : Grants Management Analysis Travel Required : Up to 25% Clearance Required : Ability to Obtain Public Trust What You Will Do : Manage submission, review, and approval of applications for child care funds by states, territories, and tribes, including preparing, reviewing, and managing correspondence to grantees for the purpose of assessing grantee performance and compliance with Federal regulations as a regional liaison for designated cycles. Prepare guidance, technical assistance resources, and other training materials to support program operations oversight of grantee implementation and administration activities. Train staff and grantees. Provide briefings and facilitate meetings and webinars for staff, leadership, grantees, and others. Collect and analyze data. Provide information and advice and prepare, update, track, monitor, and report on designated program operations and grantee implementation status, activities, issues, and accomplishments. Manage databases and spreadsheets to collect, compile, and analyze data. Develop recommendations for improvements in program operations as identified by data analysis. Prepare descriptive background and analytical reports, memoranda, and other types of written material on significant issues of legislative and operational concern for senior management, supervisors, team leaders, and staff. Such reports present and evaluate divergent professional points of view, define policy and implementation options, and identify and discuss potential consequences of adopting various options. Coordinate, carry out, and monitor special projects and initiatives focused on grantees in the Office of Child Care. Develop plans for carrying out special projects and initiatives, including determining information and resource needs, key personnel, and time frames. Works closely with officials at the grantee and national level, as appropriate. Monitor progress and keep key personnel informed of status. Assess the impact of outcomes and results. Coordinate with federal and contract staff to manage and oversee program operations activities. Provide Office of Child Care regional program stakeholders with regular reports and updates on project and work statuses, as directed. What You Will Need : Bachelor's degree. title: Consumer Transaction Monitoring Investigator
jd_text: Job Family : Investigator Travel Required : None Clearance Required : None What You Will Do : The responsibilities of the Analyst will include, but are not limited to: Performing AML alert/case reviews, seeking to mitigate risks associated to financial crimes and suspicious activity. This role is ideal for a self-motivated individual with a growth mindset who thrives on solving complex challenges and developing talent. The Director is accountable for the quality and timeliness of the team’s deliverables, manages key stakeholder relationships, and plays a pivotal role in supporting sales leaders in achieving their Mission Critical Priorities. Responsibilities include budgeting, capacity planning, forecasting, KPI reporting, trending and performance analysis, and executive presentation support. What you’ll do: Lead, coach, and develop a team of 2-4 analysts, ensuring high-quality output and timely delivery of all team deliverables. Own and execute exhibitor budget planning, headcount/capacity planning, corporate business forecasting, and trending analysis. Build analytical models to support short and long-term planning Oversee stakeholder management, building and maintaining strong relationships with cross-functional partners, including Sales, Finance, and Operations. Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholder needs, feedback, and alignment on business objectives. Deliver insightful KPI reporting and business performance analysis and trending to inform financial outlook for our sales leaders and executive stakeholders. Support creation of impactful slides and materials for executive presentations, ensuring data accuracy and clarity. Drive analysis, modeling, and performance reporting ensuring accuracy and deadlines are consistently met. Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation within planning and performance functions, including leveraging AI to enhance output, insights, and efficiencies. Communicate findings, recommendations, and insights to senior leadership Champion a data-driven approach to decision-making, leveraging analytics to solve business problems and support growth. Managing ad-hoc requests What you’ll need: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred. 8+ years of experience in FP&A, business planning, analytics, and/or sales ops and with at least 4 years in a people management role. Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing teams, with direct accountability for team output. Excellent communication skills with all levels of an organization. Ability to distill large amounts/complex information into a concise message Independent thinking and complex problem-solving skills Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience building relationships across all levels of an organization. Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills. Experience working with sales leaders and supporting executive-level presentations. Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Self-starter with a growth mindset and a passion for tackling challenges. Strong core values: integrity, collaboration, no-limits mindset, objectivity Ability to thrive and deliver outstanding results in a fast-paced environment and to maintain a positive outlook when faced with challenges What you will get: Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Medical, Dental & Vision Plans, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 401K matching, and more! #LI-KR4 Who are we? They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations. What we’re looking for : We’re looking for highly curious, bold and critical thinker who would thrive in an environment centered on producing provocative, forward-looking insights to help CFOs reshape their finance functions and enterprises for 2030 and beyond. If you’ve spent a good part of your career in strategic finance or special projects working with the CFO, get restless when the pace of change isn’t tracking with external dynamics, and are energized by challenging conventional wisdom and current ways of working, then this Gartner analyst role could be for you. title: Director, Analyst, Data Management for AI and Agentic Use Cases(Remote US)
jd_text: Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have research, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Director Analyst possesses a keen eye for identifying problems and creating solutions within the market they serve. They use their knowledge to help clients make better decisions, solve complex issues, and execute new practices that propel clients’ businesses toward key objectives. A Director Analyst publishes these insights as pragmatic and/or provocative research. Additionally, they reinforce Gartner’s value every day by engaging clients via virtual meetings, sales support, Gartner conferences and industry events. Candidates should have real world implementation experience of how data management enables AI use cases & agents, and how data agents are utilized in modern data architectures to support operational productivity. The candidate will focus on written and customer-facing deliverables to support Data & Analytics Leaders who face the challenges of improving/establishing Data Management Initiatives. What you will need: Experience with data enablement of AI and agentic use cases, have delivered live projects and have an understanding of the challenges, use cases and technology. Bachelor's Degree, Advanced Professional Qualification, or 10+ years direct experience in a field related to Data Management and AI. Knowledge of core vendors in Data Management that enable data agents, and those that support AI and agentic readiness of data. Understanding of core data management capabilities that enable and support AI and agentic use cases, such as Modern data management architectures (data fabric, data mesh, lakehouses) Knowledge graphs and their support for semantic modeling and ontology development Vector and Graph data stores (in their support for delivering context for AI) Data agents that support data engineering productivity Access to and integration of unstructured data for AI and context delivery. Techniques to support enabling AI-ready and agentic ready data. Familiarity with Chief Data and Analytics Officer (CDAO) initiatives, goals, objectives, and business value ROI. Ability to confidently speak to C-Level Executives and provide actionable insights or explain concepts targeted and relatable to their role. Strong organizational skills: ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables. Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability. Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions. Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels. Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable). Reporting directly to the GVP, this role will lead and support strategic initiatives, business planning, operational governance, and internal partnership efforts that enable GCC to achieve its growth objectives and deliver exceptional value to members. This role requires proven experience in business leadership, strategic planning, operational management, and cross-functional collaboration, with a strong ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive complex initiatives in a global environment. Drive accountability for strategic priorities and ensure alignment across GCC leadership. Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders across Gartner. Build trusted partnerships across BTI, Destination Conferences, Global Marketing, Sales, Strategy & Operations, and other key functions. Foster a One Gartner approach by aligning stakeholders around shared objectives and opportunities. Identify and execute initiatives that improve collaboration, drive business outcomes, and enhance the experience of GCC members. title: Americas Consulting Director
jd_text: Job Description Summary The Consulting Director – Americas leads the regional Functional Consulting team and is accountable for translating implementation expertise into sustained customer outcomes. The role manages and develops the team, ensures disciplined resource and delivery execution, and partners closely with Customer Success Managers and the broader Customer Success organization to accelerate adoption, improve time to value, mitigate retention risk, and identify expansion opportunities. This leader establishes a consistent customer-adoption operating model across the Americas, coordinates effectively with global adoption, product, project management, technical consulting, support, sales, and quality teams, and maintains clear visibility to priorities, capacity, risks, outcomes, and follow-through. High levels of leadership judgment, customer focus, operational rigor, and cross-functional influence are required. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop the Americas Functional Consulting team, including senior professionals and people leaders; set clear priorities, build capability, manage performance and succession, promote inclusion, and attract and retain strong talent. Own regional execution of the customer-adoption program in partnership with Customer Success Managers. Prioritize accounts using customer outcomes, adoption health, annual recurring revenue, retention risk, contractual commitments, and growth potential. Establish and maintain one coordinated adoption plan per customer, beginning during implementation where appropriate and covering stabilization, core adoption, expansion, optimization, and sustained value realization. Ensure plans identify outcomes, milestones, owners, risks, dependencies, and measures of success. Align the consulting team with the regional and global Customer Success organization so adoption definitions, health measures, account priorities, engagement models, and customer communications are consistent. Clarify ownership and handoffs among Customer Success Managers, global adoption, project management, technical consulting, support, product, sales, and quality teams. Act as a trusted partner to Customer Success leadership and account teams by providing timely visibility to customer health, adoption progress, value realization, escalations, resource constraints, and recommended interventions. Manage team capacity and deployment across implementation, adoption, acceleration-plan, non-billable intervention, training, pre-sales, and escalation support. Maintain an accurate resource forecast, make explicit prioritization decisions, and ensure effort is aligned to the highest-value customer outcomes. Drive disciplined delivery and measurable impact, including implementation readiness, adoption milestones, time to value, utilization, customer satisfaction, quality, margin, retention support, and expansion enablement. Establish clear operating rhythms and follow through on commitments. Use industry experience, equipment knowledge, software expertise, and consultative skills to guide solution design and enablement for predictive analytics, asset performance management, and other digital offerings. Build repeatable methods, templates, playbooks, and knowledge-sharing practices that improve implementation consistency and adoption outcomes across the team. Promote practical use of automation and AI within approved governance. Use Lean as the team’s operating system to focus on customer value, standard work, daily management, root-cause problem solving, and continuous improvement. Integrate applicable quality frameworks and customer-focused KPIs into team execution. Use voice-of-customer, employee-engagement, and delivery feedback to improve team effectiveness and customer experience. Create an environment in which team members raise risks early, learn from mistakes, and act on feedback. Interpret internal and external business challenges, industry trends, and customer needs to recommend improvements to products, services, processes, and go-to-market execution. Represent the Americas consulting perspective in cross-functional decisions. Lead complex cross-functional initiatives and customer escalations with moderate-to-high risk or ambiguity. Communicate clearly with leaders and customers, challenge conflicting or incomplete information, negotiate priorities, and mobilize the right resources to achieve outcomes. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. At least 15 years of progressively responsible experience in industrial software, asset performance management, asset integrity, reliability, plant maintenance, engineering consulting, or a closely related field, including significant experience in customer-facing services and complex enterprise implementations. Minimum of 5 years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of leading experienced consulting professionals and/or people leaders across geographically dispersed teams. Demonstrated success driving team performance, developing talent, optimizing resource deployment, and delivering exceptional customer outcomes in complex, customer-facing environments. Proven record of advising senior customer stakeholders, leading high-complexity engagements and escalations, and translating technical and operational expertise into adoption, value realization, retention, and growth. Desired Characteristics Deep domain expertise in one or more relevant industrial sectors, with a strong understanding of asset integrity, risk-based inspection, reliability, plant maintenance, predictive analytics, data quality, and asset performance management. Broad experience advising multiple enterprise customers across countries, operating environments, and regulatory contexts; able to adapt proven practices without losing consistency or rigor. Recognized technical and consultative credibility with customer executives, engineering and maintenance leaders, practitioners, and internal product teams; able to challenge assumptions and guide consequential decisions. Demonstrated success moving customers beyond implementation to sustained adoption and measurable value realization, including the ability to diagnose data, process, capability, and change-management barriers. Experience establishing operating mechanisms across Consulting, Customer Success, Product, Sales, Support, and Quality, with transparent measures, clear decision rights, and effective escalation paths. Evidence of external professional leadership—such as participation in industry standards bodies, technical committees, conferences, publications, or professional communities—is highly valued. Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical and business issues clearly to executives and customers. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, with a record of coaching senior talent, building followership, and creating accountability in a matrixed organization. Demonstrated ability to analyze ambiguous problems, make sound trade-offs, and resolve issues at their root cause. Demonstrated ability to lead complex programs and execute with discipline across organizational boundaries. title: Senior Product Manager, Analytics
jd_text: <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Senior Product Manager, Analytics</strong></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p>BlackSky is a real-time intelligence company. title: Technical Implementation Specialist

Minimum of 5 years of related experience in software implementation, systems administration, systems integration, technical support, or a related field. Working knowledge of networking, Wi-Fi, remote-access technologies, VPNs, firewalls, HTTPS/TLS, and system connectivity troubleshooting. Experience with web interfaces, APIs, and integration with enterprise or manufacturing systems. Strong project-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple customer implementations, priorities, and project dependencies. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical audiences. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. Ability to travel up to 10% based on business needs. The Company’s primary business language is English. title: Software Engineering Manager - Order Fulfillment Software Factory
location: Austin, Texas, United States of America
jd_text: Job Description The Role The Order Fulfillment Software Factory delivers GM’s end-to-end software for two value streams. Source to Deliver covers purchasing, supplier management, supply chain, and logistics. Order to Deliver covers how GM sells, configures, schedules, and delivers vehicles to dealers and customers. The factory is advancing GM’s SaaS First, Cloud First, and AI First direction. It works closely with GPSC Business Area IT, Sales and Marketing Business IT, and GM’s peer software engineering, mainframe, and SAP factories to deliver consistent, modern solutions at speed. We’re looking for a Software Engineering Manager who codes. You’ll lead a team of approximately 6–12 engineers with a mix of skills, sometimes including a technical lead or first-line lead, that owns a product or service area such as Vehicle Order Management, Order Scheduling, or Global Logistics. You’ll be the team’s technical anchor: scoping complex problems, designing systems, and shipping alongside your engineers. You’ll also make agentic AI coding the default way your team builds, tests, and operates software. This is a player-coach role. We expect you to spend approximately 30–40% of your time hands-on, including writing and reviewing production code, designing systems, prototyping, and working daily with AI coding agents. You’ll set your team’s technical direction and be accountable for its delivery, quality, and growth. What You’ll Do Lead the Team’s Delivery and Direction Turn the factory’s strategy into clear direction, objectives, and operating plans for your team. Allocate resources, delegate work, and reprioritize as business needs change. Own your team’s metrics and KPIs, including delivery, quality, reliability, and business outcomes, and make measurable contributions to the factory’s goals. Drive strategy and implementation for large projects that affect multiple departments and business partners, including GPSC, dealers, and suppliers. Tie technical initiatives to key business objectives and begin building your area’s technology roadmap with Product Management. Handle competing demands, sensitive situations, and conflicts within the team and with other teams. Build alignment with stakeholders who are skeptical of new approaches. Be accountable for workforce planning and operational and financial decisions in your area, including cloud and AI tooling spend. Lead Hands-On Act as the technical lead for your team’s workstream. Write, review, and merge production code for critical-path features, complex defects, and proofs of concept. Design software systems and define architecture for team-level projects, including services, APIs, event-driven integrations, data models, and SaaS/ERP integrations. Participate in architecture reviews across the factory. Guide engineers as they scope complex problems and develop creative, pragmatic solutions. Be the team’s go-to resource for technology, cross-team interfaces, and company policies and processes. Propose new technology that changes how the business works, with forward-looking impact on product experience, quality, and time to market. Own operational excellence. Participate in on-call, lead incident response and postmortems, and deliver high-quality work on schedule, with quality as the priority. Make Your Team Agent-Native Make AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot agent mode, and Cursor, part of everyday work across planning, implementation, testing, code review, refactoring and migrations, documentation, and operations. Build and maintain the team’s agent setup, including repository-level agent instruction and context files, reusable prompts and skills, MCP and other tool integrations with internal systems, and CI pipelines that run agents for automated pull-request review, test generation, and dependency upgrades. Set guardrails so agent-generated code is safe to ship, including test coverage and evaluation checks, human-review standards, sandboxing and permissions, secret and data handling, and provenance checks. Use agents to modernize legacy order and supply chain systems faster, for example by generating test harnesses for legacy code, running automated migrations, and documenting undocumented systems. Track impact through measures such as cycle time, change-failure rate, defect escape rate, and developer experience. Share what works with peer teams and help establish factory-wide practices. Build and Grow the Team Hire engineers and make internal and external staffing decisions to build the right mix of talent and experience. Hold regular one-on-ones and career conversations. Plan people resources so engineers continue to grow, and assign work that plays to each person’s strengths. Run performance management, including goal setting, feedback, calibration, and addressing underperformance. Apply company policies consistently and fairly. Coach engineers to direct, verify, and own AI-generated work, and to maintain a high bar for everything they merge. Champion change management as the team adopts agentic development. Role-model GM’s Behaviors while making room for individuality and diverse perspectives. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Applied Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Information Technology, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a related field plus 6–9 years of relevant experience; or 10–12 years of full-time relevant experience. At least 2 years of experience managing a team of software engineers with varied skill levels, including hiring, coaching, and performance management. At least 3 years of experience designing and architecting new and existing systems for reliability and scale. Current, hands-on coding proficiency in one or more of Java, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, C#, or Kotlin. Candidates will be asked to code during the interview process. At least 1 year of daily hands-on use of AI coding assistants or agents in real development work, with concrete examples of what worked, what did not, and why. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP; APIs and microservices; and modern CI/CD, code review, and source control practices. What Can Give You a Competitive Advantage (Preferred Qualifications) At least 3 years of engineering management experience, or experience leading a team that included other leads. Domain experience in order management, supply chain, procurement, logistics, dealer or retail systems, or e-commerce fulfillment. Experience integrating with SaaS and ERP platforms, such as SAP or Salesforce, and with event streaming and messaging technologies, such as Kafka. Experience modernizing legacy or mainframe systems into cloud-native services. Experience building on LLM APIs and agent tooling, including tool or function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), prompt and context engineering, and evaluation harnesses. Experience with Agile or SAFe delivery, including PI planning and working across Agile Release Trains. Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field. &#xa;&#xa;GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Supporting the Warehouse Manager, this role drives a continuous improvement approach and a strong health and safety culture, with oversight of the warehouse and distribution operation scorecard to ensure efficient, cost-effective management of goods. You'll assign daily work, and train and develop staff to ensure safe, accurate, and efficient receiving, storage, and shipping operations. Success in this role requires strong operational knowledge, a commitment to safety, and the ability to lead by example in a fast-paced distribution environment. You Will Planning & Leadership Support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives, driving strategic improvements and ensuring alignment with company objectives. Support the development of warehouse personnel, helping build the critical capabilities needed to deliver F&P's strategy. Demonstrate a leadership style aligned with the organization's purpose, values, and strategy. Own adherence to and training on standard operating procedures (SOPs). Conduct regular performance evaluations with the Warehouse Manager and provide feedback to sustain high productivity and morale within the team. Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement among warehouse staff. Prepare regular reports on warehouse activities, including inventory levels, shipping/receiving performance, and operational metrics. Analyze data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement, proposing and implementing solutions as needed. Operations Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Supervise and execute daily activities of warehouse staff, including receiving, storing, picking, and shipping parts. Lead quality control measures to ensure accuracy and condition of parts during receiving, storage, and shipping. Support investigation and resolution of discrepancies or customer complaints related to inventory or shipments. Ensure the security of stock and assets by monitoring adherence to security procedures and protocols. Support implementation of inventory control procedures to minimize discrepancies and optimize storage space utilization. Drive a results-oriented operation focused on operational KPIs, accountability, and continuous improvement. Plan resourcing to meet throughput demand and operational KPIs, ensuring optimal performance and cost-efficiency. Ensure adherence to 5S standards within the warehouse, conducting audits and inspections to maintain operational and H&S controls. Oversee warehouse MHE servicing and safety policies, invoice and spend management, and site services including recycling, waste, and utilities. Ensure compliance with labor regulations relative to your area of the DC. Health & Safety Understand and comply with all relevant Health & Safety (H&S) and environmental (HSE) legislation, as well as Fisher & Paykel's Health and Safety Policy Standards and codes of practice; keep abreast of changes in legislation and update procedures accordingly. Identify and assess potential hazards within the warehouse; ensure hazards, near misses, and incidents are reported, recorded, investigated, and risk-assessed, and implement reasonably practicable controls to prevent recurrence. Ensure all employees, contractors, and visitors receive comprehensive H&S training; conduct regular refresher courses and emergency drills to maintain high safety standards. Demonstrate visible and proactive leadership in H&S, leading by example and fostering a strong safety culture; conduct regular H&S meetings and actively engage with staff. Lead thorough investigations into incidents and near misses to identify root causes, develop and implement corrective actions, and share lessons learned across the organization. Conduct regular safety audits and inspections to ensure compliance with H&S standards, identifying areas for improvement and monitoring the effectiveness of safety measures. Track and analyze H&S performance metrics; report on safety performance and recommend actions for improvement, ensuring H&S objectives and KPIs are met or exceeded. Encourage active participation in H&S initiatives from all employees; recognize contributions to workplace safety and facilitate open communication for H&S concerns and suggestions. You Have 2–4 years of experience in warehouse operations, logistics, distribution, or supply chain environments. Experience leading, training, or coordinating warehouse teams. Experience with ERP systems, preferably JD Edwards or Oracle. Knowledge of inventory control, shipping, receiving, and warehouse processes. Experience working with freight carriers and transportation coordination preferred. Strong leadership and team coordination abilities. Excellent organizational and prioritization skills. Strong attention to detail and inventory accuracy. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Intermediate Microsoft Excel and reporting skills. Working knowledge of warehouse management systems and RF technology. Understanding of OSHA requirements, warehouse safety practices, and material handling equipment. Ability to identify issues, solve problems, and make sound operational decisions. Hourly roles accrue 20 days of paid vacation starting year 1 and exempt roles are eligible for our TAYN policy. We also offer 12 company holidays per year. Parental Leave: Becoming a new parent is a full-time job. Our new policy offers all primary caregivers 26 weeks' paid leave for the primary caregiver, a flexible return to work with reduced hours at full pay, as well as four weeks of paid leave for partners to spend time with their growing families. Wellness Initiatives such as our Fuel Up Fridays, a company-paid subscription to Calm, No-Meeting Fridays, and personalized healthcare support for your wellness journey. title: 26-119.B1 - Sr. IT Systems Analyst (SAP BASIS and Security Administrator)
jd_text: Job Objective: Works with Finance and Accounting, Asset Teams, and the Information Technology Department to understand SAP platform, infrastructure, and security needs; administers and supports SAP BASIS and SAP Security functions; and delivers projects that align SAP technology with business strategy. This role helps ensure that SAP systems operate reliably, securely, and efficiently while meeting business requirements. The position also analyzes, documents, and supports enhancement, patching, upgrade, access, and security-related initiatives across the SAP landscape. This role provides senior-level technical ownership for SAP BASIS administration, SAP Security administration, system reliability, access controls, change management, and SAP infrastructure support. The position works across IT, Finance and Accounting, Asset Teams, business stakeholders, and vendors to ensure SAP systems remain secure, available, well-controlled, and aligned with business needs. Essential Job Responsibilities: Designs, implements, integrates, and supports SAP BASIS and Security solutions with minimal guidance, using strong SAP BASIS and Security skills and a solid understanding of SAP infrastructure. Collaborates with IT, business stakeholders, and external vendors to design, support, and maintain SAP system architecture, security roles, authorizations, and integrations that meet company requirements. Troubleshoots SAP and third-party software issues by working with SAP support, application vendors, developers, and internal stakeholders to identify root causes and implement remedies. Improves existing programs by reviewing objectives and specifications, evaluating proposed changes, recommending enhancements, and making approved modifications. Serves as the project technical lead for system refresh, patch, and upgrade projects. Instrumental in the migration process from test to production using CHARM and TSM Leads the Change Control Board by managing expectations, requiring complete documentation, and ensuring adherence to company change management policies. Administers SAP security roles, profiles, authorizations, user access, and related controls in alignment with company policies, segregation of duties requirements, and audit expectations. Monitors SAP system health, performance, availability, background jobs, interfaces, transports, and related infrastructure components; coordinates issue resolution to minimize business disruption. Adheres to the company’s values – integrity, ownership, urgency, alignment, and innovation. Supports company vision and mission. Adheres to established work schedule, attendance standards and is punctual to work and meetings. Other Job Responsibilities: Builds customer confidence, is committed to increasing customer satisfaction, sets achievable customer expectations, assumes responsibility for solving customer problems, and follows through on commitments. Ensures commitments to business stakeholders are met, solicits opinions and ideas from business and IT partners, and responds promptly to inquiries. Other duties as assigned by management. Qualifications: Fifteen (15) years minimum of information systems experience, preferably in the oil and gas industry, with a strong emphasis on SAP BASIS administration, SAP Security administration, infrastructure support, system upgrades, patching, monitoring, and change management. Interpersonal skills to allow effective communication with individuals and teams. Strong ability in diagnosing and solving problems while maintaining patience, professionalism, and courtesy. Working knowledge of SAP database, operating system, server, and infrastructure concepts related to SAP system administration, maintenance, refreshes, patching, and troubleshooting. Ability to establish priorities, meet deadlines, and concentrate on detailed information in a fast-paced demanding work environment. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, supervisors, other departments, officials, and the public. Solid understanding of enterprise applications, SAP system landscapes, infrastructure tools, job scheduling, transport management, and general office applications. Ability to complete multiple, diverse tasks of differing priorities with a high degree of accuracy. Proficiency in the use and application of the following software: Required : SAP BASIS Administration, SAP Security Administration, SAP Solution Manager, CHARM, transport management, system monitoring, patching, upgrades, database refreshes, and TSM. Preferred : SAP HANA, ABAP troubleshooting, SQL, SAP Data Services, SAP RISE, PRA, UOM, audit support, and segregation of duties concepts. Education Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited four-year university or college with a degree in information technology, computer science, business administration, project management or related field of study, or relevant experience. Certifications, Licenses, Registrations: Formal training in SAP, preferred, but not required Certification in LEAN and/or Six Sigma, preferred, but not required. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, preferred, but not required.

title: Inventory Specialist - San Antonio
jd_text: JOB OVERVIEW: The Inventory Specialist is responsible for managing all aspects of the integrity of Henry Schein’s dental inventory within assigned 3PL locations and local centers; responsible to complete all inventory audits, identifies inventory deficiencies, develops the solution and implements strategic plans to ensure compliance with Company inventory standards. The position is accountable for between $2-4 million of inventory across multiple 3PL locations and centers across their assigned territory. Plays a critical role in supporting operational success in assigned centers of operation. Responsible for supporting and reporting on various aspects of Henry Schein’s operational policies and procedures. This can include but is not limited to coordinating with different departments, optimizing operational workflow, ensuring inventory compliance, presenting to leadership and Finance, and reconciling operational errors. This position will play an active role in cost savings initiatives, will lead through influence to reduce inventory write-offs, and be held accountable to results. Please note : This is a fully on-site, Monday - Friday position based out of our San Antonio, TX location. The position follows standard business hours, and candidates must be located within a reasonable commuting distance of the location. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Receives all inventory and maintains accurate records of shipments and goods received for all assigned centers of operation. Works in conjunction with internal Equipment Coordination Specialist (ECS) team to manage and reconcile all inventory shipped to customers and other locations to ensure the right equipment is delivered on time, as per customer invoicing. Conducts physical inventory audits and spot audits for all assigned centers of operation, researches any deficiencies and identifies solutions. Oversees inventory in assigned centers of operation by ensuring all 3PL and center cycle count requirements, inventory management and audits are completed successfully and timely. Manage all consignments, equipment rental returns, and warranty returns (RMA) processes for assigned centers of operation. Travel to locations in assigned areas to uncover operational inefficiencies in both Henry Schein and 3PL facilities. Report findings to leadership with suggested action plan to eliminate errors and inefficiencies. Reconcile all inventory audits to maintain acceptable inventory levels in the 3PLs and centers. Reduce operational costs by reconciling missing, lost, and wrongfully transacted inventory. Develops and maintains exceptional working relationships with vendors (3PL’s), ECS and local management team. Collaborate with team members and cross functional departments to resolve operational issues and optimize workflow. Reduce depreciated, obsolete inventory by working with Area leadership to develop ways to liquidate to save on operational costs. Oversee assigned center’s systematic locations to ensure inventory is accurately represented and accounted for. Report on assigned centers of operation key performance indicators to identify historical and trending data relating to operational performance. SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS: Advanced in Microsoft Software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience working across various data entry platforms. Strong logistics experience with high volume inventory movement. Interpersonal skills to work efficiently with others (Vendors, TSM’s, 3PL’s) for detailed follow-up. GENERAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES: Strong time management skills and the ability to prioritize work Very good attention to detail and accuracy Customer service oriented and ability to work with and resolve complex issues Ability to plan and arrange activities Excellent interpersonal communication skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to maintain confidential and highly sensitive information Ability to work in a team environment Ability to multi-task Ability to manage conflict Capacity to work effectively under pressure Analytical thinking Oversee small projects Identify and recommend continuous improvement opportunities Establish productive working relationships at multiple levels within the organization MINIMUM WORK EXPERIENCE: 4 years combined experience in equipment installation, purchasing and customer service, order processing, sales operations, inventory management or the equivalent required. PREFERRED EDUCATION: Typically High School education, vocational training and/or on-the-job training. Bachelor’s degree preferred. TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Some local travel between assigned locations (up to 25%-30%) may be required to perform monthly and quarterly cycle counts at assigned distribution centers and third-party logistics locations. The amount of travel may vary based on business needs and number of assigned locations. This position currently supports two locations in the San Antonio, TX area. The posted range for this position is $45,282 - $62,263 which is the expected starting base salary range for an employee who is new to the role to be fully proficient in the role. Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including education, prior experience, training, current skills, certifications, location/labor market, internal equity, etc. Other benefits available include: Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage, 401K Plan with Company Match, PTO, Paid Parental Leave, Income Protection, Work Life Assistance Program, Flexible Spending Accounts, Educational Benefits, Worldwide Scholarship Program and Volunteer Opportunities. title: Project Manager
jd_text: Flowserve is seeking an exceptionally organized, detail-oriented Project Manager to join our expanding aftermarket platform in Houston. This position is fueled by an intense, unyielding high volume of customer parts and infrastructure orders across our heavy industrial channels . Because this arm of our business centers entirely on the manufacturing and tracking of engineered-to-order new pumps and custom replacement components, the role demands close alignment across our primary Houston operational footprint . You will step into a fast-paced environment where managing multi-million-dollar project lifecycles is the daily norm . If you thrive on execution, enjoy high corporate exposure, and are a master of spreadsheet optimization and clear communication, this position offers a direct runway for upward career progression across Flowserve . Core Responsibilities High-Volume Portfolio Control: Manage a dynamic portfolio of 5 to 20 concurrent new pump and aftermarket parts manufacturing projects . Lifecycle Data Master: Actively manage and track all active order workflows, engineering changes, and milestones using precise tracking spreadsheets and email documentation . Cross-Functional Communication: Serve as the central communication pivot point, coordinating seamlessly across engineering leads, global buyers, sales units, and executive leadership . Constraint & Milestone Management: Intercept scope changes and material delays early to keep factory manufacturing cycles aligned with tight client delivery windows .
