title: Senior Transformation Analyst, Data & Value
jd_text: Forming Our Future together FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America. Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter. Shift: The regular hours for this position are day shift. Job Description: FormFactor is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Transformation Analyst to provide the analytical and technical foundation for the company’s highest-priority cross-functional transformation initiatives. This role will combine strong technical expertise with business and financial acumen to develop business cases, financial and operational models, portfolio dashboards, executive decision packages, and benefit-validation reporting. The successful candidate will be a hands-on individual contributor who can move from an ambiguous business problem to a trusted fact base, analytical model, executive recommendation, and sustainable reporting solution. This individual will work closely with Finance leadership, business units, IT, data engineering, and cross-functional teams and will have experience with data modeling, visualization, automation, Power BI, Tableau, Oracle Analytics Cloud, Qlik or similar tools, Python, SQL, and related analytics approaches. Key Responsibilities: Transformation Analytics and Business Cases Translate complex business issues into clear analytical questions, hypotheses, data requirements, and decision criteria. Own business cases for transformation initiatives, including baseline performance, investment requirements, expected benefits, risks, dependencies, sensitivities, and value-realization timing. Build financial and operational models to evaluate revenue, margin, cost, cash, inventory, capacity, productivity, service, and other key drivers. Perform diagnostic, scenario, sensitivity, and driver-based analysis to quantify tradeoffs and support management decisions. Partner with Finance and functional leaders to validate assumptions, reconcile initiative economics, and refresh business cases as conditions change. Data Modeling, Analytics, and Automation Extract, combine, cleanse, transform, and analyze data from financial, commercial, planning, manufacturing, operational, and other enterprise systems. Use SQL, Python, scripting, advanced spreadsheet techniques, and similar tools to automate data preparation, perform analysis, and build repeatable models. Develop trusted data models that support consistent financial and operational analysis, forecasting, and performance management. Identify opportunities to apply predictive, diagnostic, optimization, AI, or automation approaches to transformation priorities. Partner with IT and data engineering teams to define requirements for development activities and improve data access, infrastructure, data quality, integration, governance, and reporting automation. Portfolio Dashboards and Executive Decision Support Design and maintain tools, dashboards, workflows, etc., for business partners as well as for the transformation team covering scope, milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, resources, adoption, and value realization. Standardize metrics, hierarchies, master-data definitions, and calculation logic across transformation initiatives. Use Power BI, Tableau, Oracle Analytics Cloud, Qlik, or similar tools to create intuitive, decision-oriented visualizations for executive audiences. Own the analytical content of executive decision packages, including options, quantified impacts, risks, recommendations, decision owners, and required timing. Maintain decision logs and supporting datasets to create traceability from management decision through implementation and outcome. Apply appropriate development methodologies to test and release items to production. Benefit Validation and Business Partnership Define benefit baselines, KPIs, calculation methods, data sources, owners, and validation cadence at the start of each initiative. Track forecast, implemented, realized, and Finance-validated value and investigate variances between expected and actual outcomes. Ensure reported benefits are supportable, transparent, and not double-counted. Work alongside business owners to embed new metrics, models, dashboards, and decision routines into recurring management processes. Document data definitions, assumptions, procedures, and controls and transfer sustainable analytical ownership to the appropriate function. Key Deliverables: Transformation business cases and scenario models Financial and operational models supporting enterprise tradeoff decisions Executive decision packages and concise ELT reporting Portfolio dashboards, milestone views, risk registers, and decision logs Benefit baselines, validation models, and value-realization reporting Documented data definitions, analytical procedures, and sustainable handoff Preferred Qualifications & Experiences: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Analytics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline. 5+ years of experience in financial analytics, business analytics, transformation, FP&A, operations, consulting, business intelligence, or a related role. Demonstrated experience developing business cases and complex financial or operational models. Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, Oracle Analytics Cloud, Qlik, or a similar visualization platform. Practical SQL capability and experience using Python, scripting, low-code automation, or similar tools for data preparation, modeling, analysis, or workflow automation. Ability to reconcile large or inconsistent datasets and explain analytical methods, assumptions, and conclusions to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong executive communication, organization, ownership, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Experience with ERP, EPM, CRM, planning, manufacturing, data warehouse, or enterprise performance-management systems. Experience building capacity, demand, supply, pricing, cost, gross-margin, working-capital, or productivity models. Experience with APIs, Power Query, Power Automate, notebooks, Git, forecasting, statistical analysis, optimization, machine learning, or generative AI applications. Semiconductor, semiconductor equipment, electronics, capital equipment, high-mix manufacturing, supply chain, or operations experience. Advanced degree or relevant professional certification. What Success Looks Like: Success means leaders have a trusted, concise, technically sound, and financially grounded view of transformation priorities, decisions, progress, risks, adoption, and value. Analysis improves decision speed and quality, dashboards drive accountability, benefits are transparently validated, and analytical capabilities are transferred into sustainable business ownership. Skills: Analytical Method, Application Programming Interface (API), Business Analytics, Business Intelligence (BI), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Financial Analytics, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Microsoft Excel, Organizational Capacity Building, Preparation of Business Cases, Statistical Analysis, Structured Query Language (SQL), Tableau (Software) Education & Experience: Minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work | Required Equal Employment Opportunity Statement FormFactor is an equal opportunity employer. title: Workforce Scheduling Program Manager
jd_text: You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel. Job Summary The Workforce Scheduling Program Manager leads workforce planning, staffing, and scheduling initiatives across the organization. This role partners with Operations, Finance, Data Services, IT, and People teams to improve volume forecasting accuracy, optimize staffing strategies, and drive consistent scheduling practices that support operational performance and growth. As the business owner of workforce management processes and systems, the Program Manager uses data-driven insights to identify opportunities, implement best practices, and ensure effective workforce planning across the Company, a multi-site healthcare organization. This position plays a critical role in enhancing efficiency, standardization, and team member experience. Qualifications Education Required: Bachelor’s degree; experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. Licenses/Certifications Required: None Work Experience Required: 3+ years of workforce management or scheduling experience (e.g., forecasting, staffing models, capacity planning) in multi-site environment. 5+ years of health care experience. Scheduling experience in a medical environment. Experience in development, management, and enforcement of multi-site scheduling and payroll processes and best practices. Experience in use of scheduling systems or other standard tools to report on and analyze staffing level compliance, time punch compliance, and overtime utilization. Preferred Qualifications, Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience, etc.: None Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities This role involves interaction and collaboration with other departments, Joint Venture team members, and health system partners and requires excellent judgment and interpersonal skills. Workforce management and staffing‑to‑model expertise across multi‑site healthcare operations. Proficiency with scheduling and time‑tracking systems and their enterprise‑wide optimization. Knowledge of timekeeping processes, clock‑in/clock‑out compliance, and overtime controls. Ability to analyze data, build reports, and monitor schedule and staffing compliance. Skill in developing and improving standard processes and best practices for scheduling and time tracking. Familiar with integrations including flat-file exports/imports and APIs between scheduling systems and other systems such as a data warehouse of HRIS. Ability to and interest in expanding technical knowledge particularly in areas of AI-driven forecasting, automated modeling, and information distribution via automated integrations. Ability to translate business requirements from operations leaders into clear technical specifications for forecasting, optimization, and reporting enhancements, and to prioritize a backlog of improvements Experience operationalizing analytics, including building or overseeing dashboards in tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, etc. to monitor model adherence, volumes, and key SLAs Strong collaboration and stakeholder‑management skills across operations, FP&A, IT, Talent Acquisition, and health‑system partners. Effective problem‑solving and sound judgment in addressing workforce and scheduling issues. Clear written and verbal communication skills for templates, guidance, and performance updates. Ability to work independently, set priorities, and meet enterprise deadlines in a remote environment. Customer‑service orientation in supporting internal teams and external health‑system partners. Required Functional Competencies: INTERPERSONAL – Develops and maintains excellent working relationships and possesses exceptional judgment ORAL COMMUNICATION - Expresses information (ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively; listens to others and responds appropriately PROBLEM SOLVING – Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations SELF-MANAGEMENT – Sets well-defined and realistic personal goals; displays a high level of initiative, effort, and commitment towards completing assignments in a timely manner; works with minimal supervision; is motivated to achieve; demonstrates responsible behavior TECHNICAL COMPETENCE – Uses or gains knowledge necessary to perform the major functions of the role as described above SYSTEMS THINKING – Understands how operations, workforce management systems, data pipelines, and analytics tools interrelate, and can design changes that account for downstream impacts WRITING – Recognizes and uses correct English grammar, punctuation, and spelling; communicates information in a succinct and organized manner; produces written information that is appropriate for the intended audience. CUSTOMER SERVICE – Demonstrates and delivers exceptional service to health system partners, patients, and internal stakeholders in a professional, courteous, accurate, complete, and timely fashion TEAMWORK/COLLABORATION – Demonstrates skills and abilities in team/project- oriented activities. RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT – Maintains good communication and a positive relationship with Team Members at all levels of the organization and all health system partner liaisons. Essential Duties and Responsibilities · Own the ongoing execution and improvement of workforce forecasting processes including generation of staffing forecasts and dissemination of forecasts into standard templates/tools for market schedulers. · Develop and implement processes and best practices for market schedulers to adhere to schedule templates and regularly optimize schedules to staff to model (e.g., trailing volume monitoring, contingent worker shift modifications, call-out strategies, etc.). · In collaboration with analytics and IT resources, define data requirements and oversee development of automated reports and dashboards that track schedule templates and staff to model adherence. · Create and distribute monthly reports on scheduling compliance and staffing to model and undertake corrective actions with market management and schedulers. · Maintain and oversee clock-in/clock-out analysis and compliance and develop processes to improve reporting and team member adherence. · Develop processes and best practices for time tracking reporting, reconciliation, and management (OT, period end processes, etc.) · Serve as a program owner and primary subject matter expert for scheduling and time tracking solutions. · Develop and maintain standard processes and best practices for use of scheduling and time tracking solutions. · Maintain a deep understanding of how forecasting, scheduling, and time tracking tools interact. title: Implementation Manager - Data Solutions
jd_text: GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S. Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information. Since 2011, GoodRx has helped consumers save nearly $75 billion on the cost of their prescriptions. Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans. About this Role: GoodRx is seeking an Implementation Manager - Data Solutions to join our Pharma Direct team. This role will sit at the intersection of program management, client implementation, and technical execution, with a focus on bringing complex data feeds to life for pharmaceutical and media agency partners. The ideal candidate brings strong pharmacy claims-level data expertise and hands-on experience working with claims data, with the ability to understand how claims data is sourced, structured, analyzed, and translated into external-facing products and programs. They will also work with physician-level data (PLD) and should be comfortable understanding how provider-level data is structured, matched, and leveraged. They are equally comfortable driving discovery for technical requirements, managing timelines, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and gathering the technical details needed to launch and scale data integrations. They bring a strong mix of pharmacy claims and physician-level data fluency, program leadership, technical acumen, and strategic prioritization, and can translate business needs into organized data execution plans across Product, Data Engineering, Analytics, Legal, Client Success, and Sales teams. This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys building structure in ambiguous environments, driving launches from kickoff through go-live, and improving how teams deliver complex data solutions at scale. complex data requirements into clear implementation plans Partner closely with Product, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Legal, Privacy, Client Success, and Sales to translate business and client needs into scalable, high-quality data solutions Serve as the central point of coordination across internal teams and external partners, keeping data feed execution aligned, dependencies visible, best practices that reduce time to launch feeds Triage contractual agreements between internal and external Legal partners to provision data sharing between parties Create visual examples, workflows, title: Business Analyst

title: Supply Chain Data Engineer
jd_text: Forming Our Future together FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America. Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter. Shift: The regular hours for this position are day shift. Job Description: We are seeking a Supply Chain Data Engineer to assist the development of a scalable Planning Analytics and Automation capability that enables data-driven decision-making across a complex, global supply chain. This individual will work across a team to define the strategy, standards, and roadmap for planning analytics, transforming fragmented data environments into integrated, enterprise-level solutions that support SIOP and operational execution. The role combines fluency in advanced analytics, data engineering, and supply chain processes to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable analytical frameworks, predictive models, and system-enabled decision support tools. This individual will help to drive cross-functional alignment, partner with IT to operationalize solutions, and ensure that analytics capabilities are embedded into planning processes and business decisions—not just delivered as standalone outputs. Key Responsibilities: Data Automation & Process Transformation Assist with transformation of fragmented, manual planning processes into scalable, automated analytics workflows. Define and implement scalable data pipelines and data models integrating ERP, planning systems, and external data sources. Drive standardization of data flows and reduce dependency on manual data manipulation and spreadsheets. Partner with IT to ensure analytics solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture and scalable for global deployment. Advanced Analytics, Modeling & Decision Support Support design and deploy predictive and prescriptive models to support supply chain decision-making, including Demand forecasting and signal consumption, Inventory optimization and policy setting, Capacity, backlog, and shortage modeling, and Supplier performance and risk analytics. Support monthly scenario planning and what-if analysis to support SIOP and executive decision-making. Provide structured analysis of trade-offs across supply, demand, cost, and service. Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for all stakeholders. Enterprise Integration & Cross-Functional Collaboration Assist cross-functional alignment between Planning, Operations, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, and IT to define requirements and embed analytics into business processes. Serve as the bridge between business and technology, ensuring solutions are practical, adopted, and sustained. Partner with IT to deploy models, dashboards, and workflows into production environments with enterprise-grade performance and governance. Data Governance & Standards Ownership Outline data governance for planning analytics, including Data quality standards, Metric definitions, and Reporting consistency across sites. Establish frameworks for data validation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Ensure alignment with enterprise data platforms, security, and compliance requirements. Planning Analytics Strategy & Capability Development Propose actions for the development of the Planning Analytics & Automation capability; defining standards, tools, and roadmap to scale analytics across the global supply chain. Establish and standardize data models, KPIs, and planning metrics to ensure consistency and comparability across sites and functions. Identify and prioritize high-impact use cases to improve planning performance, decision speed, and visibility across SIOP and execution. Drive adoption of analytics tools and insights across planning, operations, and leadership teams. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in: Python or R, SQL (data extraction, transformation, performance optimization), and Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools. Experience with Oracle preferred. CSCP certification Understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes (demand, supply planning, production, inventory, logistics), preferably in a high-mix, low-volume environment. Demonstrated ability to design and deploy scalable analytics solutions, not just one-off analyses. Ability to translate complex data into business insights and high-level recommendations. Experience working with enterprise data environments, including ERP systems and cross-functional datasets. Experience with supply chain planning systems (Kinaxis, SAP IBP, or similar). Experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, Snowflake). title: Outreach and Engagement Coordinator, Enterprise & Procurement Service
jd_text: Outreach and Engagement Coordinator, Enterprise & Procurement Services Remote within California with 25% travel. Must reside in California We are seeking a Outreach and Engagement Coordinator, Enterprise & Procurement Services to join FoundationCCC in its mission of benefiting, supporting, and enhancing the California Community Colleges—the largest and most diverse system of higher education in the nation. Together, we are building stronger communities by getting students and colleges the resources they need to succeed and expanding pathways to economic and social mobility across California. Join us as we continue this important work to uphold the value of community colleges in building a brighter future . What You’ll Do Since 1999, EPS has been a trusted partner in the procurement space, advocating for colleges and other educational institutions. Our mission is to harness the collective buying power of colleges, cities, counties, and school districts through our innovative CollegeBuys, AICCUBuys, CivicBuys, and SchoolBuys programs. We leverage our position within the California Community Colleges, as well as partnerships with other educational and public agencies, to secure institutional contracts, offering discounts of up to 85% on a broad spectrum of products and services. The Outreach and Engagement Coordinator, Enterprise & Procurement Services supports the planning and execution of Enterprise & Procurement Services' marketing, communications, stakeholder engagement, and event initiatives. Working under the direction of the Strategic Operations Manager, this position is responsible for coordinating day-to-day marketing activities, maintaining digital communications, executing department events, and ensuring consistent branding across EPS programs. The Coordinator works collaboratively with Communications, Technology Development, vendors, and internal staff to deliver high-quality engagement opportunities that increase awareness of EPS programs and services. Outreach & Engagement: Draft and coordinate newsletters, marketing campaigns, and website content with Communications and Technology Development. Events & Stakeholder Engagement: Coordinate logistics for conferences, forums, webinars, receptions, and stakeholder meetings. Project Coordination: Maintain timelines, follow-up activities, and manage meeting agendas. Attributes for Success Relevant AA/AS, equivalent work experience, or a combination of both. Minimum of two (2) years of related work experience in marketing, communications, event planning, stakeholder engagement, project coordination, or related field. title: Accounting Manager, Payments and Platform Services Revenue
jd_text: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients. Fullsteam is a payments and software company powering the businesses behind everyday life. Through a portfolio of vertical software platforms paired with integrated payment processing, Fullsteam serves tens of thousands of merchants across North America. The Accounting team supports this growth by owning revenue recognition, billing, and reconciliation across the Payments and Platform Services lines of business. Job Summary: The Fullsteam Accounting team is seeking a highly qualified candidate for the Accounting Manager, Payments and Platform Services Revenue role. The ideal candidate will have experience in payments revenue and the ability to thrive in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. This role is responsible for ensuring the billing and revenue recognition is accurate for our Fullsteam Payments process in both the US and Canada. The Accounting Manager leads and develops the payments revenue accounting team, setting priorities, reviewing work, and building the team's technical depth as transaction volume grows. Note: This role is primarily remote, with the expectation that employees may be asked to attend meetings at our offices in Atlanta, GA, or Auburn, AL as business needs require; ample advance notice will be provided for any required travel. Primary Responsibilities: Maintain a deep understanding of the end-to-end payment transaction lifecycle, including system architecture, execution, reconciliation, and error handling.​ Oversee the accounting for the end-to-end lifecycle of money movements, including payment origination, reconciliation, and reporting.​ Manage the payments point-of-sale (POS) terminal revenue process and support operations in the billing and inventory accounting for the POS terminals. Reconcile all money movements to confirm activity happened as expected. Own the month-end and quarter-end close for payments and platform services revenue, including journal entries, accruals, flux analysis, and balance sheet reconciliations. Identify, triage, and assist with solutioning payment related incidents with cross functional and external partners. Act as an additional safeguard to detect and prevent payment errors and losses.​ Work closely with backend systems to ensure accurate and timely payment processing and reporting.​ Develop and maintain documentation for payment processes and procedures.​ Collaborate cross-functionally with risk, underwriting, sales, operations, and backend systems teams to ensure efficient and accurate payment operations, resolve variances, and drive process improvement initiatives. Support the Operational Leadership and executive team on key financial decisions. Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing accounting team. Foster a collaborative and inclusive team culture that encourages continuous improvement and professional growth. Set performance goals and regularly evaluate the team’s progress, providing feedback and guidance to ensure high standards are met. Manage the billing and revenue recognition process for Platform Services including insurance, marketing, and platform services. Accounting and reconciliation for the Merchant Capital Advance. Assist external auditors during interim and annual audits by providing documentation, explanations, and support related to revenue recognition practices and financial reporting, including audit compliance documentation as necessary. Drive and foster a positive organizational culture by exemplifying and promoting our core values and behaviors, ensuring alignment with company standards and nurturing an environment of collaboration, continuous improvement, and performance. Primary Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA certification is a plus. Minimum of 6-8 years of progressive accounting experience, including direct experience with payment processing or transactional revenue; public accounting (Big 4 preferred) background a plus. Minimum of 3 years of people-management experience with a track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-caliber teams. Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems; NetSuite, Zuora experience is a plus. Strong technical background in U.S. GAAP, with demonstrated depth in revenue recognition under ASC 606, including multiple-element arrangements and gross vs. net presentation. Working knowledge of internal controls over financial reporting, including SOX-style control design, documentation, and testing support. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to analyze complex situations and develop effective solutions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and collaborate with leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners. Execution-oriented, with strong adherence to deadlines and the ability to prioritize competing responsibilities in a fast-paced environment. Capacity to think ahead, set clear goals, and develop long-term plans that support organizational objectives. Dedicated to developing team members through mentoring and constructive feedback, and to fostering a collaborative, inclusive team environment. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment. Salary Range: $120,000-$160,000 USD Fullsteam supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience, and background. Fullsteam is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst - Enterprise Analytics
jd_text: Be Here. Be Great. Working for a leader in the insurance industry means opportunity for you. Great American Insurance Group's member companies are subsidiaries of American Financial Group. Partners with business stakeholders, data owners, analytics professionals, product managers, and cross-functional product teams to define the business concepts, measures, relationships, rules, and requirements that give analytic products consistent meaning across reports, dashboards, and AI-assisted experiences. Designs, develops, tests, and maintains reusable semantic models as core components of analytic products, organizing business entities, measures, relationships, definitions, and access rules for reporting, self-service analytics, and agent-assisted use cases. Creates and maintains the business-friendly metadata, data definitions, lineage, model diagrams, and usage guidance needed for people and AI-enabled tools to interpret and use analytic products consistently. Develops end-user guidance and training that support adoption and effective use of analytic products. Manages the analytic product lifecycle by defining success measures with business partners; monitoring adoption, quality, performance, and business impact; evaluating priority questions, expected answers, failure patterns, and escalation criteria for AI-assisted experiences; and refining products and supporting semantic models as needs, data, and AI capabilities evolve. Advises business stakeholders on analytics and AI-assisted use cases, helping teams frame meaningful questions, interpret results, improve data literacy, and determine when human review is required. Partners with product managers and business leaders to prioritize opportunities, manage dependencies and risks, influence decisions, and communicate product value to executive stakeholders so analytic products are delivered incrementally and achieve intended business outcomes. Experience: 4 or more years of advanced experience in business analysis, analytics development, business intelligence, data modeling, product delivery, or a related discipline, with demonstrated success translating complex business needs into analytic products that influence decisions and deliver measurable outcomes. Experience designing or maintaining BI applications, analytic products, or semantic models is required. Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to improve analysis, development, documentation, evaluation, or testing is preferred; machine-learning model development is not required. Scope of Job/Qualifications: Serves as a senior contributor on complex analytic products, combining business judgment, product thinking, and advanced analytics practices to shape priorities and influence senior and executive stakeholders. Translates business and technology knowledge into clear product direction, governed definitions, measures, relationships, rules, and solution guidance. Recommends effective practices and tools for product discovery, business analysis, semantic modeling, AI evaluation, testing, and documentation. May serve as a senior member of an agile product team and provides technical and professional guidance to less experienced team members. Uses AI-assisted tools effectively, validates outputs and failure conditions, protects sensitive information, communicates limitations, and maintains human accountability for business decisions. Demonstrates advanced analytical, communication, facilitation, and executive presentation skills. title: Senior Technical Solutions Manager
jd_text: Type of Requisition: Regular Clearance Level Must Currently Possess: None Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain: None Public Trust/Other Required: None Job Family: Technical Solutions Job Qualifications: Skills: Accountability, Document Management, Program Management, Project Planning, Taking Initiative Certifications: None Experience: 10 + years of related experience US Citizenship Required: No Job Description: GDIT is looking for a Senior Technical Solutions Manager to own the delivery posture across our entire U.S. Courts portfolio — currently four active call orders under the Case Management Modernization (CMM) program for the Administrative Office of the United States Courts (AOUSC). This is not a single-workstream PM role. The Senior Technical Solutions Manager will see across all four call orders, connect the dependencies between them, identify gaps and risks before they surface, and drive the program toward its contractual commitments. The CMM program is replacing the federal courts’ 30-year-old case management system (CM/ECF) with a cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS platform serving all 204 federal courts. It is a multi-vendor, SAFe-structured environment with parallel workstreams, government-controlled dependencies, and high stakeholder visibility. The ideal candidate thrives complexity and exercises sound judgment in escalations and resolutions. What You’ll Do Own cross-call-order visibility. Maintain a unified view of schedule, risk, dependencies, and delivery status across all four call orders Drive risk and dependency management Identify cross-program risks and inter-team dependencies early, track them rigorously, and drive resolution Run program-level status and governance Own the cadence: PI planning readiness, sprint-level health, milestone tracking, executive reporting Build the operating rhythm that keeps four parallel workstreams synchronized Ensure contractual alignment and flag gaps before they become findings Manage stakeholder communication and serve as the primary program interface for internal leadership and coordinate with government stakeholders. Translate technical execution status into business-level impact for both audiences. Coordinate across vendors and teams Work across GDIT delivery teams, the cloud/DevSecOps contractor, and the advisory contractor to ensure dependencies are tracked and ensure handoffs Support capture and option year planning Provide the execution data and program health visibility What You Bring Required 10+ years of technical program management experience, with at least 5 years managing multiple concurrent workstreams or contracts Demonstrated experience in government contracting or heavily regulated environments (understanding PWS/SOW obligations, CDRLs, option year mechanics, and contractual performance standards) Hands-on risk and dependency management — not just maintaining a register, but actively driving resolution and escalating with judgment Experience operating in multi-vendor delivery environments where you don’t control all the teams but are accountable for the integrated outcome Proficiency with Agile/SAFe delivery frameworks at scale (PI planning, sprint cadences, cross-team synchronization across 5+ teams) Strong executive communication, both written and verbal Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance Preferred Experience with Judiciary, DOJ, or court administration programs Familiarity with cloud-native modernization programs (legacy-to-cloud migrations, microservices, API-first architectures) PMP, PgMP, SAFe SPC, or equivalent certifications Experience with JIRA, GitLab, or similar delivery management tooling at portfolio level Background in case management, document management, or records management systems Clearance & Compliance This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust determination. Work is performed in compliance with JISF (Judiciary Information Security Framework) and FedRAMP High requirements. Location & Work Model This is a remote position. Occasional travel to Washington, D.C. or other AOUSC/GDIT locations may be required for PI planning events, program reviews, or stakeholder meetings (estimated 10–15% travel). About the Team GDIT’s Courts portfolio supports the Administrative Office of the United States Courts in modernizing the technology that serves all 204 federal courts. title: Program Manager, Product Development
jd_text: Be visionary Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins. Job Description Teledyne Micropac is looking for a Program Manager, New Product Introduction. The Program Manager, New Product Introduction (NPI), is responsible for leading cross-functional teams in the development, qualification, and successful launch of new high-reliability aerospace and defense products. This position drives projects from concept through production release, ensuring technical, schedule, cost, quality, and customer requirements are achieved. The Program Manager serves as the primary interface between engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, customers, and suppliers while managing program risks, product readiness, qualification activities, and successful transition into production. Essential duties to include but not limited to: What you'll do Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) programs from concept, proposal, and requirements definition through design, qualification, production release, and lifecycle transition. Manage and direct the execution of program objectives to ensure technical, schedule, cost, quality, and customer requirements are achieved. Lead cross-functional Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) consisting of Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, Sales, and Business Development personnel. Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders regarding program status, risks, deliverables, and technical issues. Develop and maintain integrated program plans, schedules, resource requirements, budgets, and milestone tracking systems. Coordinate product development activities including requirements review, design reviews, risk assessments, qualification planning, manufacturing readiness, and production release. Drive timely resolution of technical, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain issues that may impact program objectives. Identify, assess, manage, and mitigate technical, schedule, cost, manufacturing, and supply chain risks throughout the program lifecycle. Develop corrective action plans when deviations from established plans occur and escalate issues to leadership as appropriate. Lead phase-gate reviews including requirements reviews, design reviews, qualification readiness reviews, manufacturing readiness reviews, and release-to-production reviews. Coordinate environmental, electrical, mechanical, reliability, and customer qualification activities required for product acceptance and release. Support Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Testability (DFT), cost reduction, yield improvement, and production optimization initiatives. Coordinate prototype builds, pilot production activities, process qualifications, and transition of products into sustained manufacturing. Monitor and analyze program performance using schedule, cost, risk, and technical metrics. Provide regular status updates and executive-level reporting to senior management. Perform schedule and cost variance analysis, including Earned Value Management (EVM) principles where applicable. Ensure compliance with customer requirements, contract obligations, AS9100, ITAR/EAR, DFARS, military specifications, and company policies and procedures. Allocate and manage program budgets including labor, materials, outside services, travel, and qualification testing expenses. Foster collaboration, accountability, and effective communication among cross-functional team members while resolving conflicts and removing obstacles. Ensure successful completion and closure of programs, including documentation, lessons learned, and transition to sustaining operations. Support proposal development activities, project planning efforts, Basis of Estimates (BOEs), business cases, and product roadmaps. Support, communicate, reinforce, and exemplify the mission, vision, values, and culture of the organization. Occasional travel to customer, supplier, and partner locations as required. What you need Proven experience leading new product development and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs from concept through production release. Strong understanding of product development lifecycles, phase-gate processes, and product launch methodologies. Experience managing technically complex aerospace, defense, electronics, semiconductor, microelectronics, optoelectronic, or high-reliability manufacturing programs. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders without direct organizational authority. Experience planning and executing product qualification activities, including environmental, electrical, mechanical, and reliability testing. Strong understanding of manufacturing readiness, process qualification, production transfer, and supply chain integration. Experience with risk management, issue resolution, and corrective action planning throughout the product lifecycle. Knowledge of program management tools including Microsoft Project, scheduling systems, and resource planning tools. Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM), cost tracking, variance analysis, and financial forecasting. Working knowledge of AS9100, ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and military/aerospace product development requirements. Experience supporting proposal development, project estimation, budget planning, and contract execution. Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, conflict resolution, and decision-making skills. Excellent presentation, communication, and customer relationship management skills. Demonstrated success managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Business, or a related technical discipline - required Minimum of 7 years of program management, project leadership, product development, engineering, or related experience in aerospace, defense, electronics, semiconductor, microelectronics, or other high-reliability manufacturing environments - required Experience leading cross-functional product development teams and managing new product introduction activities - required Ability to effectively communicate with customers, suppliers, executive leadership, engineers, manufacturing personnel, and technical stakeholders - required Demonstrated experience managing program schedules, budgets, risks, and customer deliverables - required Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, and program management tools - required PMP certification preferred. title: Project Manager
jd_text: What You'll Be Doing Job Scope: The Project Manager is generally responsible for performing all aspects of project management for moderately complex engineering project assignments ensuring total delivery of the services on time, within performance budget and quality expectations. This work will be performed under minimal supervision from our Pasadena or Angleton office. Primary responsibilities will include but not be limited to: Efficiently manage promotional projects minimizing the cost to Hargrove by working with the Engineering Resource Leaders to accurately estimate Professional Services man hours to complete the project while achieving the objectives. Successfully managing commercial contract(s) on one or more projects of various sizes, as required. Ensure that invoices are paid in a timely manner, Project Change Notices are processed, monthly Office Earnings Report (OER) is reviewed in the time allotted, and the project(s) plan in Vision is current. Maintaining control of the project by tracking and maintaining discipline performance budget progress, schedule commitments, and quality standards. Understanding and utilizing the project tools that are available for project control. Participating in development of all major technical, cost, scheduling and performance decisions on assigned projects. Familiarity with project scope, specifications, deliverables required by client, and design criteria upon assignment to a project and gaining Hargrove team alignment of schedule and budget in regard to deliverables required. Work with client team to define project scope, goals and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with stakeholders. Recognizing and communicating scope and design changes promptly by championing the Project Change Notice process and promoting a positive Change Management culture. Leading the effort in building a productive Team both within Hargrove and with the client. Utilize rewards where applicable to recognize outstanding contributions. Coordinating resource requirements with other ongoing project work and insure all parties’ expectations are aligned. Planning and organizing the work of your team. Communicating the plan to your team, the project leadership team and the client. Aligning the expectations of all parties. Conduct weekly coordination meetings with the Team. Maintaining timely and accurate reporting including weekly and monthly reports utilizing a comprehensive action item list. Reviewing engineering documents, vendor submittals, fabrication drawings and other construction submittals for compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, good engineering practice, and project objectives. Project Manager is responsible for ensuring all documentation is reviewed and checked against vendor submittals, specifications, interdiscipline, etc. regardless of resource location. Ensuring that standard project work processes are followed by all team members through all phases of engineering, procurement, and construction. Interviewing discipline leads to maintain up-to-date progress against man hour expended analysis. Project Manager is responsible for overall financial health of each project with the respective discipline leads being responsible for producing the required deliverables within the given budget. Assessing the performance of the project team members through the course of the project, and work with resource leadership to organize a qualified and motivated project team. Ensuring project documentation is properly reviewed and approved by the client. Providing Construction Phase Support, start-up assistance, and response to Requests for Information, as needed. Managing timeliness of client team decision making and package approval. Promoting continuing positive relations with the client building on long term relationships that continue to add additional services. Completing project closeout as required by the client. Effectively and proactively managing the client needs at all stages of the project. Ideal Background Education: Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Civil Engineering from an accredited university is preferred. Certification: Professional Engineering and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) registration is highly preferred. Experience: Requires up to 10 years of relevant experience in engineering and project management. Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Knowledge of the Hargrove project execution procedures. Knowledge and application of company business standards and good practices. Knowledge and application of company engineering standards and project controls tools. Demonstrated proficiency in complex project management. Ability to lead a team to deliver on commitments. A comprehensive understanding of the function of all engineering disciplines, procurement, and construction processes. Ability to manage client relationships in complex situations. Ability to relate easily to others in the business community such as customers, suppliers, contractors, government, professional and trade associations. Ability to handle stress with poise. Understanding of existing and potential customer needs and preferences. Ability to delegate authority appropriately. Ability to set priorities. Demonstrated leadership ability with team orientation. Coaching and mentoring skills and experience. Excellent listening and communication skills, both verbal and written. Excellent presentation skills. Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office. Physical Requirements: Ability to sit, stand, or walk for long periods of time. 77034 Hargrove Culture We work to create an environment founded on trust, personal integrity, and a “team mentality” so that each person understands the value of their contributions both on a project and company-wide level. title: Lead Project Manager
jd_text: About us HMH is a leading provider of drilling solutions, offering a wide range of products and services that are designed to be the safest and most efficient in the industry. Apart from our expertise in land and offshore operations, we are continuously expanding our knowledge within subsea mining, geothermal, onshore and offshore construction, as well as offshore wind industries. With offices in 16 countries across five continents, HMH maintains a strong global presence. HMH is a frontrunner in developing and providing automation and digital solutions for our drilling customers to support their endeavor to improve efficiency and environmental footprint. Equipped with its brilliant team of engineers, HMH is committed to actively exploring opportunities in other industries. For us, this means new opportunities and challenges that we need creativity and great minds to solve in our efforts to innovate our future. Do you want to join our team? At HMH we value our employees. We offer exciting job opportunities that will give you the opportunity to grow in your role and give you the professional development you deserve. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, you will join a casual and inclusive work environment. Our environment is based on respect and having a good day at work, so you can expect to join a knowledgeable, global team who help each other to succeed. Join Our Team Our Project Management Team is dedicated to delivering exceptional post-sales support to our global customers. We ensure seamless assistance from project initiation through to completion for subsea equipment, including comprehensive full stream packages. Our commitment includes providing expert technical support, reliable services, and promptly addressing any customer requests to ensure optimal performance and satisfaction. Role Summary As a Lead Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful delivery of projects, maintaining profitability, and ensuring utmost customer satisfaction through efficient management of project-related activities and resources. Responsibilities Project Delivery Excellence: Lead the timely delivery of services, upgrades, and new-built projects, ensuring adherence to predefined scope, timelines, and budgetary constraints. Scope Definition and Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to define project scope and objectives, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical feasibility. Robust Project Planning: Develop comprehensive project plans to effectively track progress, anticipate potential challenges, and facilitate proactive decision-making. Change Management: Employ appropriate verification techniques to manage changes in project scope, schedule, and costs, while mitigating associated risks. Performance Measurement: Utilize suitable systems, tools, and methodologies to measure project performance and identify areas for optimization. Effective Communication: Regularly report project status to relevant stakeholders and escalate issues to management as necessary to ensure transparency and alignment. Client Relationship Management: Cultivate strong relationships with clients and other stakeholders, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring their needs are met throughout the project lifecycle. Risk Mitigation: Conduct thorough risk assessments and implement proactive risk management strategies to minimize project risks and ensure successful outcomes. Vendor Relationship Management: Establish and maintain productive relationships with third-party vendors and service providers to ensure seamless collaboration and fulfillment of project requirements. Documentation Management: Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, status reports, and other relevant records to support effective project governance and knowledge transfer. Skills/Requirements Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with at least 5 years of work experience) Minimum of 5 years of experience in projects, services, or related production experience. Proven track record of managing teams to deliver project objectives. Strong understanding of project management methodologies, tools, and best practices. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing priorities, and adapt to changing circumstances in a dynamic environment. Proficiency in project management software/tools (e.g., MS Project, JIRA) and Microsoft Office Suite. Additional Information Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis, now or in the future, without employer sponsorship for employment visa status No relocation assistance Location Houston, TX (JFK)

title: Aviation Project Manager II
jd_text: What We're Looking For At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners. This opportunity entails being responsible managing assigned aviation project(s) throughout their full lifecycle at an international airport. This position includes participating in contract negotiations and overseeing the delivery of the project plan to successfully accomplish HNTB’s 4 for 4 performance: delivery of quality work, on time, on budget and to the client’s satisfaction on every project. This position proactively manages the budget, schedule, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and client communications in support of the project’s objectives. Coordinates with internal and external partners including cross-discipline and functional teams to address and problem solve design related issues or concerns. The Project Manager II – Engineering typically manages multi-disciplinary project team(s) for one or more strategic projects in excess of $100M. What You'll Do: Responsible for development of the project scope and fee quotation and assists in the preparation of technical proposals and contracts in accordance with HNTB's Sophisticated Contracting Approach (SCA). Leads or actively participates in client contract scoping and negotiations. Serves as the primary client liaison and manages the project team to deliver the scope, schedule and budgets to completion and to the client’s satisfaction. Leads client contract scoping and negotiations. Performs technical discipline tasks including analysis, reports, design, specification, and production for assigned projects. Implements the firm’s project delivery plan using HNTB's Sophisticated Delivery Approach (SDA) on each project. Leads the development and the execution of the project management plan. Supervises and mentors team to overall project objectives. Leads proposal development and interview presentations for strategic, mini-mega, and mega projects to the client as well as general presentations within the industry and community. May be responsible for the recruitment, hiring, development and retention of staff, including development of plan for staff reporting, performance and compensation reviews, and succession. Performs other duties as assigned. What You'll Need: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and 10 years of relevant experience 2 years of successful management of engineering projects What You'll Bring: Winning, contracting, and successfully delivering 4for4 (on-time, on-budget, quality, client satisfaction) on multi-disciplined projects. Leading a team on mid-sized and/or moderately complex projects inside and outside of HNTB using sub-consultants. Using system tools to manage, monitor, and deliver mid-sized and/or moderately complex projects. Leading with minimal assistance from the Office Management Team in implementing HNTB Sophisticated processes as applicable to the project. Serving as the lead interface with the client on moderately complex projects. Developing successors to work with same client on other work. Job Description: The Role Fidelity is building its next generation contact center platform to deliver highly reliable, intelligent, and scalable customer engagement. We are seeking a Director of Engineering to help design, build and operate its voice platform foundation. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role within the Voice Platform team. Platform design for SIP routing, session control, media services, conferencing, recording, playback, DTMP, codec negotiation, transcoding, and call-state management. Develop reusable voice services and APIs that abstracts underlying telephony and enable teams to safely consume voice capabilities. Build and optimize Kamailio routing logic, transcation handling, registration, toplogy hiding, load balancing, failover, authentication, and security controls. Build and extend FreeSWITCH applications, dial plans, modules, event itegrations, media services, and call-control capabilities. Design for high availability, geographic redundancy, horizontal scalability, fault isolation, graceful degradation, and disaster recovery. Establish observability standards for the voice platform. Provide team technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and direct participation in complex engineering work. Partner closely with architecture, product management, contact center engineering teams, security, networking, and quality engineering. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s of master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related technical discipline or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of software development experience with significant experience in voice, telephony, realt-time communications, or programmable communications services. 5+ years of hands-on production experience with FreeSWITCH and Kamailio. Deep understanding of FreeSWITCH architecture and hands-on experience configuring, extending, embedding or integrating FreeSWITCH in production systems Deep understanding of Kamailio architecture and SIP-routing configuration. Experience integrating Kamailio with FreeSWITCH clusters, carriers, and SBCs. Expert-level understanding of voice protocols. Familiarity with session border controllers and telecomunicaions security patterns. Strong software engineering skills in C, C++, Java, or Go. Experience developing distributed, event-driven, real-time, and low-latency services. Experience with relational and non-relational databases, distributed caches, and high-volume event processing. Experience deploying and operating voice workloads in Cloud, hybrid-cloud, or geographically distributed environments. Proven experience mentoring senior engineers and raising engineering standards across teams. Hand-on experience with AI-assisted software development tools to accelerate implementation, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while maintaining engineering quality and security standards. Demonstrated ownership of production services, including incident response, root-cause analysis, remediation, and continuous reliability improvements. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing or modifying native FreeSWITCH modules or extensions in C or C++ Experience building or operating a large-scale CCaaS, CPaaS, UCaaS, or carrier voice platform. Experience building voice capabilities for contact center workflows. Experience with telcom fraud protection, STIR/SHAKEN, call authentication, and abuse prevention controls. Experience with voice analytics, speech recognition, text-to-speech, real-time transcription, media streaming, or AI enabled voice applications. Shift: The regular hours for this position are day shift. Job Description: The New Product Introduction (NPI) Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) Coordinator is the primary operational link between Engineering, the Integration Team, and Manufacturing during the introduction of new products and first articles. The role owns the coordination and accurate setup of new products in PROMIS, Agile, Oracle, and related factory applications; drives the cross-functional readiness and factory-acceptance process; supports engineers in converting technical requirements into executable manufacturing flows and documentation; and trains the Manufacturing organization before product release. You will be responsible for managing system configuration, troubleshooting IT issues, and supporting the implementation of MES solutions. Key Responsibilities: Factory Application and Product Setup Own the end-to-end creation, maintenance, validation, and release of new-product and first-article setup in PROMIS, Agile, Oracle, and other manufacturing applications. Receive new-product introductions from the business unit and coordinate the initial review of existing designs, demand, product requirements, and source-factory information. Coordinate the creation and validation of manufacturing routings, operation sequences, part numbers, bills of material, product structures, revision levels, and supporting master data. Work with Process and Equipment Engineering by manufacturing area to define process steps, equipment requirements, toolsets, recipes, and required controls before creating the factory flow. Verify that each manufacturing operation references the correct work instruction, drawing, specification, recipe, material, tooling, inspection, and quality requirement. Coordinate required application changes with Engineering, Planning, Quality, Supply Chain, IT/Business Systems, and Manufacturing. Deliver high-level training and support end users, ensuring they are equipped to fully leverage the MES system. Serve as the Manufacturing interface with IT and business-system owners for PROMIS, Xsite, INFICON, and other systems needed to execute and monitor the product flow. Perform readiness checks and resolve or escalate system and data gaps before first-article or production execution. Maintain configuration alignment across PROMIS, Agile, Oracle, released engineering documentation, and the approved factory flow. NPI Coordination and Factory Readiness Coordinate the cross-functional introduction of new products from initial planning through first article, learning cycles, and manufacturing release. Develop and maintain NPI readiness plans, milestones, action registers, risk lists, and launch schedules. Facilitate NPI readiness reviews and ensure clear ownership, due dates, follow-up, and escalation of open actions. Coordinate design-for-manufacturability review and confirm that requirements are addressed before material is run. Lead the preliminary review and secure formal factory acceptance of the proposed product flow before first-article material is released. Confirm readiness of applications, materials, tooling, equipment, documentation, quality requirements, production controls, and trained personnel before execution. Coordinate first-article builds, learning cycles, and early production activity; document issues, decisions, and lessons learned and drive actions to closure. Finalize and release the approved PROMIS flow after factory acceptance and completion of required changes. Provide clear status communication to functional leaders and stakeholders. Product Data and Material Readiness Coordinate new-product bill-of-material introduction and ensure required components, consumables, and materials are identified before execution. Coordinate material changes and verify that approved revisions are reflected consistently in Oracle, Agile, PROMIS, work instructions, and production planning. Partner with Planning, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing to establish ordering requirements, stocking strategy, and appropriate minimum/maximum inventory levels for new products. Track material-readiness risks and escalate shortages, master-data gaps, or ordering constraints that could delay first articles or production release. Engineering and Documentation Support Assist engineers in preparing, formatting, routing, and releasing manufacturing work instructions and supporting documentation. Translate released engineering requirements into clear, operator-ready execution steps while preserving engineering ownership of technical content and approval. Coordinate reviews to ensure work instructions accurately reflect process sequence, recipes, materials, tooling, safety requirements, inspection criteria, queue-time limits, and reaction plans. Identify inconsistencies among engineering specifications, application data, work instructions, and actual factory execution and coordinate correction. Support document and configuration change control throughout NPI and production release. Manufacturing Training and Launch Support Develop and coordinate training plans for manufacturing supervisors, technicians, and operators prior to product release. Train the Manufacturing organization on new-product flows, application transactions, work instructions, documentation requirements, and critical quality expectations. Partner with Engineering and subject-matter experts to ensure technical training content is accurate and complete. Maintain training materials, attendance records, qualification checklists, and completion status. Provide hands-on floor support during first articles, learning cycles, and early production until the product is transferred to routine manufacturing ownership. Gather operator feedback and coordinate improvements to documentation, systems, and training. Preferred Qualifications & Experiences: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field, or equivalent experience. Experience in IT, PROMIS systems, or a related industry, with hands-on experience using PROMIS MES systems. Experience creating or maintaining product data, manufacturing routings, bills of material, work instructions, or factory master data. Demonstrated ability to coordinate work across multiple functions and drive actions to completion without direct authority. Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, written communication, and verbal communication. Ability to understand technical information and translate it into clear manufacturing execution and training content. Ability to work effectively with engineers, technicians, supervisors, operators, planners, quality personnel, and business-system teams. Experience with PROMIS or another manufacturing execution system (MES). Experience with Agile PLM, Oracle ERP, or comparable product-lifecycle and enterprise-resource systems. Experience with Xsite, INFICON, or comparable factory monitoring and manufacturing support applications. Experience supporting first articles, engineering builds, product transfers, or factory launches. Working knowledge of configuration control, engineering change control, quality systems, and document-release processes.
